lead: The origin of cells, treated not as a single spark but as a staged sequence of nonequilibrium transitions at an alkaline hydrothermal vent, each one a falsifiable step a simulation can pass or fail. The guiding hypothesis is the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of life: the vent-ocean interface hands a nascent cell its first free energy (a natural proton gradient across thin mineral walls), its first reduced carbon (H2-driven CO2 reduction), and a place to concentrate and enclose that chemistry, before the cell evolves its own membranes, pumps and genes. The campaign builds that vent from real geochemistry upward (serpentinization, reactive transport, H2-driven carbon fixation, self-amplifying networks) and runs the classical favorable scenario and the 2026 unfavorable reassessment head to head rather than assuming either. Every stage is a coupled Vivarium composite of genuine simulators (PHREEQC, FiPy, eQuilibrator, libRoadRunner, with a FEniCS/dolfinx FEM solver under pixi as a high-fidelity cross-check) under explicit conservation contracts. Twenty-three studies build and run on real simulators. A fourteen-stage arc from vent geochemistry through carbon fixation, protometabolism, individuality, compartmentation, internalized bioenergetics and heredity to ecology, escape, and the nitrogen/phosphorus/energy/growth bottlenecks passes its pre-stated gates, with an adversarial vent-ablated control rejected by every discriminating gate. The sharper findings come from re-grounding each stage on higher-fidelity model classes, which returns three honest negatives: carbon fixation's limiting step is structure-sensitive, no autocatalysis emerges at vent conditions without a one-carbon feed, and og-08's {pump, importer, heredity} set is not jointly sufficient off-gradient.

at_a_glance.role: The vent environment a cell would form in — the serpentinizing reactor (settles in the Lost City window over ~80% of the grid), its calibration (12.5% of plausible vent states bind, H2-limited), and the sharpened coupled interface that supplies H2 / inorganic carbon / pH-redox gradients + a CO2-reducing electrochemical driving force but throttles on a bounded two-regime DIC window; qualified — a viable geochemical reactor within bounds (no origin claim; the testbed downstream chemistry draws on).
The cell's first carbon — H2-driven CO2 reduction; reproduce lab benchmarks; map the flux region

Network persistence — the carbon-fixing network sustains net carbon throughput as a connected system under vent-realistic feed + washout (supported); persistence is driven, not autocatalytic: under rule-generated real thermodynamics no self-amplifying motif emerges at the vent feed (formose only with exogenous formaldehyde, p=0.04 vs matched nulls), and the curated rTCA motif is reclassed as imposed + element-unbalanced. A provenance-gated reaction atlas supplies the balanced reactions both arms draw on. Endogenous autocatalysis (A2) is the separate og-autocatalysis line.

Spatial concentration & individuation — long tight pores cross the concentration/retention threshold (Baaske regime cleared, accumulation Peclet 18.4) while open pores wash the feed through, and at equal vent feed the concentrating pore ignites the full network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species) vs a matched well-mixed control that stays dark; the benefit is a bounded porosity window. Also resolves Gate A1 feed-plausibility.

Self-compartmentation — from a self-made amphiphile boundary (retention without isolation) to the first self-maintaining protocell whose membrane pays on persistence, with real fatty-acid vesicle MD replacing the phospholipid stand-in; studied at several fidelities as arms

Proto-energetics — capturing geochemical free energy into a transferable store, internalizing it under selection, and coupling a carrier; which coupling chemistry pays, studied at several fidelities as arms (the carrier buys dip-persistence, not more total throughput)

Heredity — an inherited chemical difference transmitted and selectable, studied at several fidelities as arms: competing inheritance modules (need not presume RNA; compositional/hybrid escape the Eigen length catastrophe), the information-per-cost frontier of six mechanisms, and a reproducible selectable fitness difference (parent-offspring correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control); qualified

Protocell ecology — a cross-feeding community out-produces the best single lineage (margin causally cross-feeding) and community function precedes cell completeness; studied as arms (og-36 stochastic community-vs-single, og-07 metacommunity, og-07-alt real metabolite exchange)

Escape and progressive independence from the vent — the minimum innovation set off-gradient, then a graded, attributed map of which innovation internalizes which support, bounded by an honest negative on joint sufficiency across model structures
Adversarial control: the gates must reject generic non-vent chemistry
Nutrient bottlenecks — reduced nitrogen keeps pace with carbon and reactive phosphorus co-concentrates in the pore (or limits first), studied as nitrogen + phosphorus arms

Reproduction — metabolism-coupled growth to a measured-geometry division with viable daughters, building a multi-generation lineage; studied at several fidelities as arms (og-33 coupled growth+division, og-growth-division fate, og-growth-alt physical reproduction)

Carbon-fixation mechanism map: the vent wall as a galvanic cell — which limitation (thermodynamic, electrical, catalytic, transport) stops carbon fixation where, and whether the empirical and Butler-Volmer classes agree on it; charge + electron ledger

question: Could the first cells have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents? Can a physically plausible early-Earth vent–ocean interface generate and sustain, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, self-amplifying chemistry, concentration, and compartments a protocell needs — without inserting metabolism, membranes, or heredity by assumption?
hypothesis: Under field- and lab-consistent parameter ranges, a serpentinization-fed, spatially resolved alkaline vent reproduces the conditions for a cellular origin: it crosses, in order, falsifiable thresholds for sustained carbon fixation, network persistence, concentration/individuality, compartmentation, internalized energy, and heritable organization — with identifiable parameter regions where each step fails.

executive.what_is_this: A staged, falsifiable Vivarium campaign testing the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of cells — treating a cellular origin as coupled transitions from geochemistry to bioenergetic autonomy, grounded in serpentinization-driven alkaline hydrothermal vents, with explicit competing scenarios.
executive.campaign_synthesis: Campaign synthesis — the whole origins-of-life-vent arc in one place (see campaign-synthesis.md). The required spine (Gates A–D) is complete: a vent-fed chemistry persists (A1, in a concentrating pore), concentrates (B), compartments and maintains itself (C), and reproduces and inherits a selectable chemical trait (D) — each gate judged against a matched null with input fluxes held equal, Gate D a genuine positive. Endogenous autocatalysis is refuted under vent conditions for both representable routes (A2, off-spine), on thermodynamics and on a seed-independence discriminator. The campaign-level reading is that concentration, compartmentation and energy coupling (Gate E study 35, qualified) alike buy persistence and robustness, not productivity.
executive.gate_a_status:
Gate A (chemical emergence) is recorded as two sub-gates, split because they answer different questions and sit at different places in the spine. A1 (network persistence) is a spine gate and is met, qualified. A2 (endogenous autocatalysis) is an off-spine branch - tested and refuted, not a prerequisite for the spine.

A1 - network persistence (spine; met, qualified): a sustained, connected, carbon-fixing network emerges on bounded geochemical feeds. In a well-mixed system the six-carbon network ignites only at about 20x the vent posterior feed, above defensible vent concentrations; Gate B (og-30) bridges that gap - a concentrating mineral pore at a modest, physical porosity (0.88, pore-local ~0.023 M) ignites the network, confirmed directly on the C6 network (flux +4.49e-4, connected), where a matched well-mixed control stays dead. The rescue holds within a bounded, somewhat brittle pore-geometry window (porosity ~0.80-0.90): below it enrichment is sub-threshold, above it pore-local feeds are physically implausible. So a carbon-fixing network persists at vent-realistic feeds inside a pore, within that window - this is what Gates B and C build on.

A2 - endogenous autocatalysis (off-spine branch; refuted, mechanistic): self-amplification beyond a degree-preserving matched null is refuted under vent conditions for both candidate routes, each with a distinct mechanism; this is a tested-and-refuted branch, not a spine prerequisite. (i) Formose (linear): the canonical doubling step (r409, two glycolaldehyde to threose) is thermodynamically condensation-favored (standard free energy -16.4 kJ/mol), so its splitting direction carries no net flux; and on a coefficient-free functional discriminator it is refuted again - the network fixes carbon but production is seed-independent, i.e. feed-driven rather than self-amplified. (ii) rTCA (branched): under vent H2 a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out, because the reductive carboxylations (succinate to alpha-ketoglutarate, +18 kJ/mol; acetyl to pyruvate, +31 kJ/mol) run uphill under H2 and too slow against washout - the same reason real rTCA uses ferredoxin, not H2, as its reductant. The rTCA topology is shown autocatalysis-capable and topology-specific in a labelled counterfactual (lowering the carboxylation barrier switches it on), so the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a limitation of the cycle's wiring.

Overall: the spine advances on persistence - A1 is met (qualified: holds in a pore, within a bounded porosity window) and is what B (met), C (partial) and D build on - while endogenous autocatalysis was tested and refuted along the way (A2, off-spine, both representable routes under vent conditions). The autocatalysis-capable rTCA topology under a stronger reductant is noted as the basis for a possible beyond-vent follow-up, outside the current vent scope.
executive.gate_b_status: Gate B (spatial organization) is met. At the same vent-posterior base feed held equal (CO2 and H2 at 1e-3), a concentrating mineral pore at a modest, physical porosity (0.88; enrichment ~23x; pore-local ~0.023 M) ignites the reaction network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, a connected network of 17 persistent species) while a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control does not (flux ~0, not connected) - spatial concentration is the only difference, so the pore itself causes the productive flux, and Gate B's criterion is met at the demonstrated pore. A porosity sweep shows this is a bounded, somewhat brittle window rather than a broad swath: net carbon flux rises monotonically with confinement (no flux washout), but the connectivity-defined ignition occupies a band around porosity ~0.80-0.90 (pore-local ~0.01-0.2 M) - below it enrichment is sub- threshold, above it the pore-local feeds become physically implausible (0.70 -> 2.6 M, 0.60 -> 36 M) and the connectivity metric itself degrades (flipping 1/0/1 across adjacent porosities). The result is confirmed directly on the C6 network - the one og-29 found ignites only at ~20x well-mixed feed - which ignites in the demo pore at the vent-posterior feed (flux +4.49e-4, connected, 22 species) while its matched well-mixed control stays dead, with the same bounded-window behavior (no flux-washout upper bound). Beyond meeting its own criterion, Gate B resolves Gate A's open A1 feed-plausibility question: the ~20x well-mixed ignition gap is bridged inside this physical pore window, so a carbon-fixing network persists at vent-realistic feeds in a pore.
executive.gate_c_status: Gate C (self-compartmentation) is qualified. og-31 tests the "benefits from it" half under a reduced-coupling membrane model (retention/access, explicitly NOT the MD-resolved permeability PMF): on the Gate-B pore- concentrated, carbon-fixing (not autocatalytic) network at the Jordan-2019 vent-calibrated setting (retention 0.905, access 0.997), an endogenous membrane raises the standing metabolite pool to about 2.9x the no-membrane ablation - it pays for itself on persistence - while net fixation flux is about 0.6x (lower), because throughput is feed-limited. og-32 (First Self-Maintaining Protocell) then takes full Gate C on an MD-informed first cut: short Martini CG-MD gives a thicker long-chain bilayer (di-C16 2.870 nm vs di-C12 2.325 nm) -> lower permeability (0.256) -> higher retention (0.661), so composition sets permeability sets retention (a resolved coupling, not a free knob); the membrane raises the standing pool ~1.98x over a no-endogenous-membrane ablation (persistence) while net flux stays ~0.79x (throughput feed-limited), and it is self-maintaining on the measurable criterion (net amphiphile production >= degradation and beats the ablation at equal feeds), within a windowed integrity (membrane access >~0.45; degradation rate k_deg <= ~0.01/s). Qualified: persistence not throughput, windowed, and MD-informed rather than PMF-resolved (the gold standard is tracked as og-32a). Guardrail: the metabolism here is the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network, not autocatalysis (A2 is refuted under vent conditions) - the claim is that a persisting network makes a membrane that pays for itself on persistence, never that the chemistry self-amplifies.
executive.verdict: The full geochemistry-to-heredity arc runs end to end on real simulators, with conservation held to machine precision, and the campaign adjudicates its scenarios rather than asserting them. The sharpest results come from re-running each stage on higher-fidelity model classes under a feasibility / robustness / discrimination standard, and the honest headline is a spine that advances on persistence while endogenous autocatalysis was tested and refuted along the way. On the spine, a rule-generated C/H/O reaction network emerges and fixes carbon and then persists at vent-realistic feeds once a concentrating mineral pore is added - Gate A1 (network persistence) is met, qualified: a connected carbon-fixing network ignites inside a physical pore (porosity ~0.88, pore-local ~0.023 M) where a matched well-mixed control stays dead, within a bounded, somewhat brittle porosity window (~0.80-0.90), confirmed directly on the six-carbon network (Gate B met). Endogenous autocatalysis, by contrast, is refuted under vent conditions for both representable routes - Gate A2, an off-spine branch, each with a mechanism: the formose doubling step is thermodynamically condensation-favored (-16.4 kJ/mol) so its splitting direction carries no net flux, and on a coefficient-free discriminator production is seed-independent (feed-driven, not self-amplified); a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out under vent H2 because its reductive carboxylations run uphill (+18, +31 kJ/mol), the same reason real rTCA uses ferredoxin, not H2 - though a labelled counterfactual shows the rTCA topology is autocatalysis-capable under a stronger reductant, noted as a possible beyond-vent follow-up. An endogenous membrane then pays for itself on persistence (standing pool ~2.9x reduced-coupling, ~1.98x MD-informed, over a matched no-membrane ablation) but not throughput, within a membrane-access window - Gate C qualified (og-31 reduced-coupling plus og-32's MD-informed first self-maintaining protocell, where composition sets permeability sets retention; PMF-resolved gold standard tracked as og-32a). Reproduction and heredity follow as a genuine positive - Gate D qualified: the protocell grows from its own amphiphile production and divides at a measured area-doubling geometry (og-33), and a daughter-inherited compositional difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference (parent-offspring fitness correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control, og-34), both against matched nulls at equal feeds. The optional Gate E extension is complete, all three qualified: an energy carrier buys dip-persistence not more total work (og-35), a cross-feeding community buys productivity ~1.9x but pays in robustness (og-36, the counterpoint), and a budget leave-one-out maps a conditional, coarse-budget independence with heredity the irreducible substrate - an affordability map, not a demonstrated escape (og-37). The earlier, lower-fidelity arc stands as the scaffold these sharpened: a Lost City vent (og-00) holding its window over ~80% of the swept grid with exact charge balance; H2-driven carbon fixation benchmarked against Preiner and Hudson (og-01); thermophoretic individuality, amphiphile compartments, internalized bioenergetics bounded by the Sojo cost, heredity that need not presume RNA, metacommunity robustness, and the {pump, importer, heredity} escape set (og-02 through og-08), plus the nitrogen, phosphorus, energy-currency and growth/division modules. An adversarial vent-ablated control is rejected by every discriminating gate, so the gates are vent-specific rather than generic. Three honest negatives are the sharpest of these: carbon fixation runs but which limitation stops it is structure-sensitive (the Butler-Volmer and empirical classes agree on the label only 47% of the time against an 80% gate, so the mechanism map, not a pass, is the result; charge/electron ledger exact on 750 runs); the eight-solute mixture fractionates rather than co-localizing in one thermophoretic pore (concentrating one tracer is not concentrating the set a protocell needs together); and og-08's {pump, importer, heredity}, re-asked inside one persistent world across 24 model structures, is not jointly sufficient (recorded as a hypothesis generator). The vent calibration anchors the arc: conditioning on the Lost City windows leaves a posterior in which 100% of the empirically supported vent states supply what carbon fixation needs, transport-class-independent, with the ledger exact (0 of 96 points rejected). So the campaign's result is a mechanism map and an honestly-advanced, now-complete spine, not a declaration of success: a carbon-fixing network persists at vent-realistic feeds in a pore (A1), self-amplification does not occur under vent conditions (A2 refuted, both routes), a membrane earns its cost on persistence (C qualified), and the protocell reproduces and inherits a selectable trait (D qualified), with the optional Gate E extension complete (og-35/36/37 qualified). A single through-line runs across the independent mechanisms: robustness is the consistently hard-won and consistently traded axis - the pore, the membrane and the energy carrier each buy persistence/robustness not throughput, the ecology (og-36) is the counterpoint that buys throughput by spending robustness, and independence (og-37) is an affordability map rather than a demonstrated escape. The honest caveats stay explicit (coarse budgets, lumped feeds, MD-informed not PMF-resolved, compositional not template heredity), each a named og-Na follow-up; the full gate-by-gate arc is in campaign-synthesis.md. What remains open is editorial (publication scope, bottleneck-map framing) and a few expert priors (the Hadean ocean's H2 / organic floor, heredity attachment thresholds, membrane permeabilities) - decisions, not unrun science.
executive.verdict_detail: Twenty-three studies, the fourteen-stage arc (the geochemistry-to-heredity stages, the nitrogen / phosphorus / energy / growth bottleneck modules, an adversarial control) plus nine calibration and -alt studies spanning every stage, wired into a DAG and all run. Each runs a coupled Vivarium composite of real tools (PHREEQC + FiPy; eQuilibrator; libRoadRunner; a FiPy thermal trap; amphiphile self-assembly; bioenergetic internalization; an agent-based heredity lineage; a pore metacommunity; an osmotic growth/division compartment; a Butler-Volmer galvanic cell) and is graded on its conservation and acceptance gates. Headline numbers: og-00 holds the Lost City window (T 40-91 C, pH 9.0-10.8, positive H2 flux) over ~80% of the swept grid with |charge| = 0; og-01 reproduces the Preiner/Hudson yields and shows the Tutolo arm halve the usable proton-motive gradient (427 -> 43 mV); og-02 reaches a peak autocatalytic gain ~29.5 in its earlier reduced model - superseded under vent conditions by og-29's higher-fidelity refutation (Gate A2: autocatalysis refuted for both representable routes); og-06's compositional / hybrid heredity is seed-robust (0.878 +/- 0.005, 5/5 graded seeds); og-08's escape set is irreducible (full set survives 1.0, any single knockout 0); og-cal's Lost-City-conditioned posterior is 12.5% of the prior yet 100% viable downstream and transport-class-independent (ledger 0/96 rejected). og-01-cal builds the vent wall as a Butler-Volmer cell in the Altair-2025 current window (7 of 8 gates pass, ledger exact on 750 runs) but its attribution gate fails at label agreement 0.47. The adversarial control is rejected by all five discriminating gates (min margin 1.8 decades) while the vent passes all five. The designed arc that sharpened this scaffold (og-27 through og-37) is now complete on main. The spine lands A1 (persistence, qualified) through B (spatial rescue, met), C (self-compartmentation, qualified: og-31 reduced-coupling ~2.9x and og-32 MD-informed ~1.98x standing pool over a no-membrane ablation, with composition -> permeability -> retention resolved) and D (reproduction + heredity, qualified: og-33 metabolism-driven division at a measured area-doubling geometry, og-34 parent-offspring fitness correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control under selection), with A2 refuted for both routes (og-29 formose seed-independent and -16.4 kJ/mol; og-rtca reductive-TCA uphill +18/+31 kJ/mol under vent H2). The optional Gate E extension is complete and all qualified: og-35 energy carrier (dip useful work 0.030 vs gradient-only 0.006 kJ/mol, total work NOT improved 0.256 vs 0.282, ledger closes ~9e-19); og-36 ecology (community productivity ~1.9x over the best single lineage, cross-feeding-causal, but more variable with lineage loss at low counts - productivity-yes / robustness-no, the counterpoint); og-37 progressive independence (all three validated channels affordable to internalize, conditional on heredity and pump efficiency >~0.7 - an affordability / attribution map, not a demonstrated escape). Every gate is judged against a matched null with input fluxes held equal; the gold-standard follow-ups (og-32a/33a/34a/35a/36a/37a) are tracked, not hidden.
decisions_resolved: Baseline parameterization: run BOTH arms — classical favorable (Russell/Lane/Sojo) and the 2026 unfavorable reassessment (Tutolo/Jackson) — so the campaign adjudicates rather than assumes. Implemented in og-01.

Primary geochemistry engine: real PHREEQC (phreeqpython + vendored llnl.dat), which fields the Lost City pH endmember once peridotite (not dunite) is reacted. Reaktoro was conda-only and off the uv path.
Build order: geochemistry + transport first (og-00/og-01), then the reaction network (og-02) — not a thin end-to-end skeleton. This put a real composite in the workbench at stage 0.

Heredity strategy for og-06: compare all modules without presuming RNA. og-06's agent-based lineage grades RNA-like template, compositional (GARD), a template-focused hybrid and a non-heritable control head-to-head; compositional and hybrid heredity persist length-independently (functional persistence ~0.88, seed-robust 5/5 graded seeds) where a long low-fidelity template suffers the Eigen length catastrophe — so heredity need NOT presume a long high-fidelity RNA template.

Explicit electrochemistry for og-01: built, but not adopted as the gradient-efficiency abstraction — the carbon_fixation face adds a real Butler-Volmer galvanic-cell class (Nernst half-cells, Koutecky-Levich transport limits, Preiner electron branching), with MineralConductivityProcess deriving gradient_efficiency from the wall circuit and a ChargeLedger auditing the Kirchhoff/faradaic residuals. The empirical gradient-efficiency class is kept as og-01's graded default.

Carbon-fixation limitation attribution + default class (resolved by Eran): ACCEPT the structure-sensitive limitation attribution AS the carbon-fixation result — the empirical and Butler-Volmer classes disagreeing on the limitation label in the favorable region (agreement 0.47 < 0.8) IS the finding, reported as the og-01-cal-electrochemistry mechanism map with gate_status failed (an honest negative); the gate is not re-tuned to force a pass. KEEP empirical as og-01's graded/headline default and butler_volmer as the registered high-fidelity electrochemistry class (the same FiPy-grades / FEniCS-cross-checks pattern), revisiting butler_volmer as the headline once Altair per-condition data turns its calibration window into a fit.

Carbon-fixation follow-up (accepted, not done): attach the Altair-2025 per-condition current / product time courses (turning the calibration window into a likelihood) and bridge CatMAP/Cantera to run the microkinetic carbon_fixation class under pixi, then re-run the mechanism map with three classes. Deferred because the per-condition dataset is not yet in-workspace and the microkinetic backend needs a pixi env.

og-03 retention gate (resolved by Eran): RESTATE it at the resolvable Peclet rather than the >=1e6 enrichment fold — the extreme fold is the closed-cell/reduced-model FiPy exp(Pe) figure the resolved FEM does not confirm above Pe ~ 13, so localization is gated on the Peclet, not the fold-magnitude. The gate change itself is implemented in a separate og-03 PR; recorded here as the decision-state.

og-08 {pump, importer, heredity} required-set (resolved by the og-08-alt rebuild): the per-driver one-at-a-time withdrawal resolves the attribution confound — the required innovation set is DRIVER-SPECIFIC, not a universal triple. {pump, heredity} rescues the vent-pmf gradient (a hard dependency: the full set rescues its withdrawal in only ~4.2% of structures), while mineral access (0.958) and feed (0.75) are freely/borderline survivable needing no specific innovation, and the importer is never individually required. The earlier "no subset jointly sufficient / hypothesis generator" reading was the gradient's rarity dominating the lumped all-at-once collapse (og-08-alt is now gate_status passed / verdict qualified; confound_resolved, ledgers close). So the campaign's endpoint statement reads "driver-specific rescue, the vent drive the hard dependency," not "no subset sufficient." The ocean-floor H2/organic prior remains an open refinement (still in decisions_needed).

scientific_argument.main_claim: Cells could have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents. On real geochemical and chemical engines, a serpentinization-fed vent-ocean interface supplies, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, self-amplifying chemistry, concentration, compartmentation, internalized bioenergetics and heritable organization a protocell needs, each as an independently falsifiable nonequilibrium transition. The full arc passes its pre-stated gates and an adversarial vent-ablated control is rejected by every discriminating gate, so the campaign adjudicates the vent mechanism rather than illustrating one story. The sharper contribution is where the higher-fidelity re-grounding breaks the easy story: the limiting step in carbon fixation is structure-sensitive, autocatalysis needs a one-carbon feed, the prebiotic mixture fractionates instead of co-localizing, and og-08's escape set is not jointly sufficient off-gradient. Each failure is a mapped parameter region and a discriminating prediction, not a dead end.
evidence_for: H2-dependent mineral-catalyzed CO2 fixation (Preiner, Varma, Huber)
pH-gradient-driven CO2 reduction with isotope controls (Hudson, Altair)
thermophoretic concentration in pores (Baaske, Mast & Braun)
evidence_against: in-situ pH/sulfur/longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume (Tutolo 2026; Jackson 2016)
no validated vent pathway spans to open-ended heredity (Module J)
lab yields are not Hadean environmental concentrations

the chemically-necessary prebiotic mixture fractionates rather than co-localizing in a single thermophoretic pore (co-localization map; surrogate and dolfinx FEM agree on both verdict and degree after the reconciliation) — the fractionation is SORET-DRIVEN — low-S_T species such as ammonium lag the strongly-thermophoretic ones (adsorption is kinetically negligible over the transit), a candidate spatial incompatibility for assembling the set a protocell needs together
caveats: Every quantitative anchor is laboratory or field provenance, not a measured Hadean environmental concentration — the campaign tests whether each mechanism is feasible and where it fails, not that these exact values held on the early Earth.

A few headline magnitudes are solver-sensitive extrapolations, not resolved results — notably og-03's enrichment fold (the reduced FiPy accumulation column reaches ~10⁸-fold, 9.6×10⁷, at accumulation Péclet ≈ 18, where it diverges ~5.6 decades from the resolved FEniCS/dolfinx field above the Pe ≈ 13 the FEM resolves); the defensible claim there is that localization occurs and is bounded, not the exact fold-magnitude. The resolved 3-D flow-through FEM solve (the localization stage) shows single-pore enrichment is strongest at low Péclet and washes out as flow rises (1/(1+Pe/pe0)), so that extreme fold belongs to the convection-enhanced closed-cell (recirculating) regime, distinct from the resolved flow-through result.

The chemically-necessary prebiotic MIXTURE does not all concentrate in the same place — the co-localization map finds the eight-solute mixture FRACTIONATES in a single thermophoretic pore, SORET-DRIVEN — the strongly-thermophoretic species concentrate while low-S_T species such as ammonium lag, holding the co-localization index low in the strong-Soret regime (~0.18, rising toward ~1 where the Soret contrast is weak). Adsorption is kinetically negligible over the pore transit (FEM mobile fraction 0.93–1.0), so it is not the cause. After the surrogate↔FEM reconciliation the surrogate and dolfinx FEM agree on both verdict and degree (within ~2–19%; coloc_index 0.176 vs 0.171 at Pe=1/×8). Reported as a candidate incompatibility, not a passed gate — concentration of one tracer is not concentration of the set a protocell needs together.

The stages currently run as separate composites with hand-carried parameters and a division counter rather than one persistent world whose bigraph restructures; until the Full Modeling Plan architecture lands (references/full-modeling-plan-integration.md), "a boundary forms" and "an individual divides" are scalar readouts, not changes in the composition itself.

key_claims.claim: Alkaline hydrothermal vents sustain a natural proton gradient across thin inorganic (Fe/Ni-sulfide) walls — a geologically free energy source a nascent cell could tap before evolving its own membrane and pumps.
Serpentinization of olivine delivers a sustained supply of H2, the reducing power that drives prebiotic chemistry at the vent.
That H2 reduces CO2 to organic carbon on native-metal and mineral catalysts without enzymes, reproducing the acetyl-CoA–like chemistry thought ancestral to life.
Nonenzymatic reaction networks (reductive-TCA fragments) can persist and self-amplify under continuous vent flow, a precursor to metabolism.
Thermal gradients in vent pores concentrate molecules by thermophoresis — a route to localized, individual-like accumulations against dilution.
Fatty-acid vesicles can assemble and persist under vent-like temperature and pH, giving the chemistry a compartment.
The classical favorable picture is contested — in-situ pH, sulfide availability and vent longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume, so each step is run against that challenge.

studies.name: og-vent-environment
studies.title: The Vent Environment: A Bounded but Viable Geochemical Reactor
studies.question: Is a serpentinizing Lost City-type vent a viable geochemical reactor that supplies the H2, inorganic carbon, pH/redox gradients and electrochemical driving force downstream chemistry needs — and within what bounds, as the mineral interface evolves and across the plausible range of vent states?

findings.statement: Outlet settles at 50.6 °C and pH 9.37 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).
findings.explanation: Real PHREEQC peridotite serpentinization (Ca-OH endmember) + FiPy transport; pH is a genuine speciation result, not tuned.

findings.statement: Serpentinization delivers a sustained H2 reducing-power flux (min 2.75e-4 mol/s over the back half of the run).

evidence.observed: 2.75e-4 mol/s

findings.statement: PHREEQC charge balance is conserved exactly (|charge|=0) and the FiPy FVM spatial-flux divergence is held to 4.9e-5 — within the 1e-3 contract tolerance (not machine epsilon).

evidence.observed: |charge|=0, |flux residual|=4.9e-5 (within 1e-3 tol)

findings.statement: The Lost City pH endmember required reacting PERIDOTITE (olivine+pyroxene), not dunite — Ca released once Mg is consumed buffers the fluid to pH ~9.5.
findings.explanation: Olivine-only buffers at ~7.8 (brucite); adding diopside gives the Ca-OH endmember that reproduces field pH.

findings.statement: The vent wall convects. Solving Darcy–Boussinesq porous flow (a stream-function Poisson ∇²ψ = −buoyancy·∂T/∂x on the real FiPy mesh) gives a buoyant recirculation cell — the hot alkaline conduit rises, the cold ocean sinks, convective velocities ~5× the background upflow (Peclet ~8) — rather than a prescribed uniform upflow. The recirculation mixes cold ocean inward, settling the outlet ~8 °C cooler (59 → 51 °C) while staying inside the Lost City window; flux conservation is preserved within the solver tolerance (flux residual ~5e-5, within the 1e-3 bound).

evidence.observed: recirculation cell (cold-left sinks, hot-right rises); vmax ~5× background; outlet 50.6 °C

findings.explanation: FipyReactiveTransportProcess now solves the stream function each step and advects T + solute with the divergence-free Darcy velocity (u=∂ψ/∂y, v=−∂ψ/∂x + upflow); ψ contours are the streamlines the cross-section viz overlays. buoyancy=0 recovers the old constant upflow.

findings.statement: Habitability is a bounded REGION of the (olivine reaction rate × flow velocity) operating space, not one tuned run — the real PHREEQC + FiPy vent settles inside the Lost City window (T 40–91 °C AND pH 9.0–10.8 AND H2>0) over ~80% of the swept grid (115/144 points). The FAIL regions are a cold-washout band at the fastest flow (17 cold points) and 12 points at the flow extreme that fall outside PHREEQC's 0–100 °C validity (recorded NaN → FAIL); the baseline operating point sits safely inside the window.

evidence.observed: 115/144 (80%) habitable over (olivine_rate 0.005–0.4 × flow_velocity 2e-4–3e-2); 17 cold-washout FAILs, 12 out-of-range NaN; baseline (★) in-window at 50.6 °C / pH 9.37

findings.explanation: The vent_habitability_phase_map sweeps the real serpentinizing reactor and reduces each point to the habitability PASS flag (settled outlet in-window with a positive H2 flux); rendered as the Lost City habitability map (Decision view). Enough serpentinization to drive H2 + alkalinity and slow enough flow to hold 40–91 °C / pH 9.0–10.8 bounds the habitable band.
findings.next_action: Sweep pyroxene_fraction (ol/px ratio) and seawater-mixing dilution to bound the pH endmember (og-00b).

findings.statement: Feasibility and robustness, in the plan's sense: 6/48 prior draws (12.5%) settle inside every Lost City window, and 6/6 of those (posterior-viable fraction 1.00) also satisfy og-01's requirements — dissolved H2 >= 1 mM at the interface, pH gradient >= 3 units against pH 6.0, T <= 100 C. One supporting parameterization: flow 3.2e-4 m/s, olivine_rate 0.38, pyroxene 0.54, fe 0.26, heat partition 6.2e-4, DIC 1.4 mM -> 49.2 C, pH 9.38, H2 10.8 mmol/kg, delta pH 3.38.

evidence.observed: consistent 6/48; viable|consistent 1.00 (both transport classes)

findings.explanation: ABC rejection on the vg-data windows (outlet T 40-91 C; pH 9.0-10.8; H2 1-15 mmol/kg) over a 48-point Latin-hypercube prior of the six free parameters of the real PHREEQC + FiPy world, then the downstream-requirement mask on the accepted set. Artifact: artifacts/vent_environment_report.json.

findings.statement: The dissolved-H2 window binds: 48/48 draws pass the pH window, 47/48 the temperature window, only 6/48 the H2 window (39 fall below 1 mmol/kg, 3 above 15). The posterior narrows the inflowing DIC from the prior 1.2-17 mM to 1.2-2.9 mM and pushes the reaction extent high (olivine_rate 0.09-0.38 vs prior 0.02-0.35), with fe_fraction 0.14-0.26. Mechanism: at full redox equilibrium in llnl.dat the Fe(II) budget first reduces the fluid's DIC (toward CH4 — Lost City's abiogenic methane); free dissolved H2 appears only once that carbon sink is exhausted, so H2 is a threshold in (fe_fraction x olivine_rate) / DIC, not a smooth function of the Fe budget.

evidence.observed: per-observation acceptance pH 48/48, T 47/48, H2 6/48; DIC posterior q05-q95 1.2-2.9 mM vs prior 1.2-17 mM

findings.explanation: Direct PHREEQC probe: at olivine_rate 0.15 / DIC 2 mM, fe 0.25 gives 4.6 mmol/kg H2 (pe -9.6) while fe 0.10 gives 0 (pe -7.4); raising DIC to 15 mM at fe 0.25 also gives 0. This is an equilibrium-model statement: a kinetic (non-equilibrium) carbon-redox class on the serpentinization face would shift the threshold — recorded as the structural uncertainty to test next (Reaktoro / PFLOTRAN; decision in the investigation).

findings.statement: Outlet pH is 9.38-9.91 for every one of the 96 runs regardless of flow, reaction extent, DIC or Fe budget — the peridotite (Ca-OH / tremolite-diopside) assemblage buffers it, so the pH observation accepts the whole prior and carries no information about the parameters. Morris mu* for pH is <= 0.11 on every parameter (vs 23 for H2 on olivine_rate). og-00's "pH in window" gate is therefore a reproduction of the buffer, not a constraint on the vent's operating point.

evidence.observed: pH range 9.38-9.91 over 96 runs; mu*(pH) <= 0.108; pH window accepts 48/48

findings.statement: Discrimination, in the plan's sense: the convecting (Darcy-Boussinesq) and prescribed-uniform-upflow FiPy classes agree on consistency and viability for 48/48 identical draws (structure agreement 1.00, model-form uncertainty 0.00). They are told apart only by outlet temperature (paired standardised difference d = 0.89; convection settles ~2 C warmer at nx = 20), not by pH (d = -0.54 at a 0.02-unit scale), dissolved H2 (d = 0.00) or pe (0.06). Whether the wall convects is a structural choice og-00's conclusions do not depend on.

evidence.observed: agreement 1.00 on viability; d(T) = 0.89, d(H2) = 0.00

findings.explanation: Same 48 draws run through model_spatial_transport = fipy and fipy_uniform_upflow (buoyancy 0); the serpentinization source is identical, and the outlet pH/H2 are set by speciation, not by the wall's flow pattern. The FEniCS class (a merged dolfinx alternative, run under viva-fenics's pixi env) is a third available class on this axis, held out of this uv-.venv ensemble — not a forthcoming addition.

findings.statement: Morris screening (r = 4 trajectories, 28 world runs): dissolved H2 is controlled by olivine_rate (mu* 23.0), fluid DIC (20.8) and flow (16.9), weakly by fe_fraction (3.1), not at all by pyroxene fraction or heat partition; outlet temperature by the heat-partition fraction (2.16), flow (1.47) and olivine_rate (0.84). The two conditioning readouts that carry information (T, H2) are controlled by disjoint parameters, so the posterior factorises: T pins heat_to_fluid_fraction, H2 pins the Fe-budget-to-DIC ratio.

evidence.observed: mu*(H2): olivine_rate 23.0, fluid_dic 20.8, flow 16.9, fe 3.1; mu*(T): heat_to_fluid 2.16, flow 1.47, olivine 0.84

findings.explanation: Elementary effects on the log-scaled prior bounds of the vg-data package; artifact ensemble.morris.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: the ConservationLedgerProcess closes exactly on all 96 ensemble runs and on the 120-tick canonical run — integrated H2 / alkalinity / heat sources equal the accumulated pools bit-for-bit (residual 0.0), PHREEQC charge imbalance 0, FiPy flux-divergence residual <= 1.1e-14, and serpentinization heat is released, never absorbed (energy_directionality 1). No prior draw was rejected by PHREEQC (0 failed points), so the posterior is not truncated by engine validity.

evidence.observed: mass residual 0.0; energy residual 0.0; charge 0; flux <= 1.1e-14; 0/96 failed

findings.explanation: The og-00 contract's four invariants (mass_balance, charge_neutrality, spatial_flux_conservation, energy_directionality) are now all machine-witnessed; energy_directionality was previously declared but not computed.

findings.statement: The interface's supply↔throttle behavior is a sharp two-regime cliff, not a gradual depletion: across a dense fluid_dic sweep (2–20 mM) real PHREEQC carbonate saturation crosses SI=0 at ~3.2 mM, and the interface either SUPPLIES (undersaturated, SI<0: H2 flux 2.75e-4 → 3.55e-5 from 2.0 → 3.0 mM, no precipitation, pore open at porosity 0.96–0.97) OR THROTTLES-AND-CHOKES (supersaturated, SI≥+0.7: precipitation 0.23–0.29 and catalytic-accessibility drop ~0.12, but H2 flux crashes four orders to ~1e-8 and porosity collapses to 0) — never both. No fluid_dic sustains flux AND exercises throttling with the pore open (window_exists=False), so the self-limiting carbonate chemistry forces the vent operating point into the undersaturated regime. The free-energy/mass/charge ledger closes at every sweep point.

Over transport timescales the interface delivers H2 and inorganic-carbon fluxes and a maintained pH/redox gradient at or above the levels used by published vent-reactor and H2-dependent-metabolism work; the study reports the full time series and the onset of decay, not a single terminal value.

Precipitation and surface passivation reduce reactive surface and throttle catalytic supply on the mineral-evolution timescale — the interface is depleting, and the study quantifies the crossover time at which delivery drops below the downstream-required threshold.

The cross-interface electrical driving force is non-trivial and of the sign/scale needed to drive CO2 reduction, verified independently by a FEniCSx Nernst–Planck solve against the FiPy transport result.
Mass, charge and energy close across the coupled PHREEQC+FiPy+Reaktoro solve to tolerance with no untracked feeds.

The study emits the full 27→29 transfer bundle — H2 + inorganic-carbon flux, pH, T, ionic activities, catalyst (mineral-surface) state and time-dependent feeds — as the typed boundary condition study 29 consumes.

studies.claim: Across fidelities the vent environment is a viable but bounded geochemical reactor. The serpentinizing reactor settles inside the Lost City window (50.6 C, pH 9.37, sustained H2) over ~80% of the operating grid — habitability is a bounded region, not one tuned run (og-00, supported). Conditioning on the Lost City field windows, 12.5% (6/48) of the empirically motivated prior reproduces all three observations and 100% of that posterior supplies the H2 + pH gradient downstream carbon fixation needs; dissolved H2 is the binding observation, pH is buffered and non-discriminating (og-cal, supported, calibrated). The sharpened coupled interface delivers H2 / inorganic-carbon flux + a maintained pH/redox gradient at or above required levels and a CO2-reducing electrochemical driving force, with mass/charge/energy closing across PHREEQC+FiPy+Reaktoro — but precipitation and passivation throttle supply on the mineral-evolution timescale and the supply<->throttle is a sharp two-regime DIC cliff, so delivery is bounded (og-27, canonical, qualified). Consolidated headline: qualified — a viable vent reactor within a bounded window, supplying downstream chemistry conditionally. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.

derived.insight: Outlet settles at 50.6 °C and pH 9.37 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).

studies.name: og-01-geology-to-reduced-carbon
studies.title: The First Carbon
studies.question: Can geological H2 drive CO2 reduction on vent mineral catalysts strongly enough to sustain a source of reduced organic carbon?

contract.note: bigraph-schema typed ports (_type/_units/bounds) + conservation predicates; the composite built for this study must declare a ProcessContract matching this face (audited via the workbench §Contract panel).

resolved_uncertainties: A viable favorable regime exists; formate strictly requires the pH gradient + H2 + catalyst.

The (vent pH × H2) fixation landscape is now mapped (14×14 sweep, open-flow sustained throughput), not inferred from a single run — the favorable region is broadly productive and scales with both the gradient and H2.
remaining_uncertainties: The continuous gradient_efficiency threshold between the favorable and Tutolo-collapse regimes (the phase map shows two levels; a third axis would resolve the boundary).

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Extend the phase map with T and pressure facets and a continuous gradient_efficiency axis to locate the viable-fixation boundary.

findings.statement: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

evidence.observed: formate=200 mM, acetate=100 µM, pyruvate=10 µM

findings.explanation: Real eQuilibrator ΔG'-gated, lab-calibrated mineral kinetics over the pH gradient.

findings.statement: Formate is present with the pH-gradient proton-motive force and collapses to <1 mM in every control (no gradient / no H2 / no catalyst).

evidence.observed: favorable 200 mM; all controls <1 mM

findings.statement: The Tutolo-2026 in-situ arm collapses the usable proton-motive gradient (pmf 427 → 43 mV), the discriminating test the campaign must survive.

evidence.observed: favorable pmf 427 mV vs Tutolo 43 mV

findings.explanation: Real FiPy Nernst-Planck electrodiffusion with a gradient_efficiency knob (1.0 favorable, 0.1 Tutolo).

findings.statement: Real eQuilibrator ΔG' is logged every step and makes feasibility explicit (fixation stops where ΔG' ≥ 0 — genuine product inhibition).

Carbon fixation SPENDS the proton gradient — a conserved proton budget (≈2 H⁺ per carbon) draws the loaded pmf down ~40% below the open-circuit 427 mV under load, then relaxes as products saturate. The gradient does work and is consumed, not merely correlated with reduction.

evidence.observed: pmf open-circuit 427 mV sags to ~250 mV (charge 0.60) at peak fixation, recovers to 427 mV

findings.explanation: A ProtonBudgetProcess integrates reservoir = supply − protons_per_carbon·carbon_flux − leak·reservoir; fixation reads the loaded pmf = pmf_open·(reservoir/capacity), closing the respiratory-control feedback.

findings.statement: A parameter sweep over the (vent pH × dissolved H₂) plane maps the carbon-fixation landscape, not a single run. In the open-flow reactor, sustained reduced-carbon throughput scales with both the pH gradient and H₂ (6.4 → 24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s; steady pool 7–28 mM); the Tutolo-2026 gradient collapse roughly halves it on the same axes, and the no-gradient / no-catalyst / no-H₂ controls zero it. The favorable region is broadly productive — the sharp dependence is on a SUSTAINED gradient, not on sitting at one pH/H₂ point.

evidence.observed: favorable 6.4–24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s vs Tutolo 2.2–15; controls 0

findings.explanation: 14×14 sweep of the real open-flow composite (pH 7–11 × H₂ 0.1–20 mM, exponential washout) reduced to sustained throughput per point; rendered as the carbon-fixation phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_phase_grid.py.

studies.claim: Over Fe/Ni/S catalysts the model reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy - formate about 200 mM, acetate about 100 uM, pyruvate about 10 uM - and sustains net organic-carbon flux inside a bounded region set by the pH gradient and dissolved H2, while the no-gradient, no-H2 and no-catalyst controls collapse it. A discriminating in-situ arm (Tutolo-2026) shows the usable proton-motive gradient falling from 427 to 43 mV, roughly halving the sustained flux. Because the CO2-reduction kinetics are lab-calibrated to Preiner rather than derived from first-principles surface chemistry, this establishes a computational bridge from serpentinization to an organic-carbon feedstock, not yet metabolism.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Preiner/Hudson organic-carbon benchmarks with the controls behaving correctly.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real thermodynamics (eQuilibrator) + electrochemistry (FiPy NPP) explain both the favorable regime and the Tutolo collapse.

derived.insight: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

studies.name: og-network-persistence
studies.title: Network Persistence: Does the Carbon-Fixing Network Sustain Itself?
studies.question: Under continuous vent-realistic feed and washout, does the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persist and sustain net carbon throughput as a connected system — and does it do so by endogenous autocatalytic amplification or merely by sustained driven flux — each arm tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?

findings.statement: The measured tier reproduces the nonenzymatic metal-promoted carbon-fixation and reverse-Krebs-like segments from the primary literature as balanced, source-keyed records (metal- promoted rTCA sequences; Fe-driven synthesis/breakdown of universal precursors; native-iron CO2 reduction to acetyl-CoA-pathway intermediates).

The inferred tier extends connectivity from C1–C3 to functional products only where eQuilibrator ΔG feasibility holds and a justified rate form/range is attached, each flagged is_range with its thermodynamic model recorded — no inferred reaction is promoted without that explicit basis.

No record with mass_balanced=false, charge_balanced=false, or a missing source_key enters atlas.vN.jsonl — the deterministic validator rejects it at write time. This zero-leakage guarantee is the study's core deliverable.
Candidate energy-coupling and Fe–S / UV-driven steps relevant to downstream energy carriers (study 35) are catalogued with their experimental anchors and confidence tiers.
The atlas emits the 28→29 transfer bundle — canonical species, balanced stoichiometry, rate forms, parameter bounds and confidence tags — as the typed reaction set study 29 consumes.

At the vent posterior feed the rule-generated universe (121 species, 413 reversible reactions, C <= 4) sustains 14 persistent species and a net CO2 fixation of 2.2e-5 mol/s but contains NO persistent autocatalytic motif (0 flux-carrying simple cycles with gain > 1); all 24 matched nulls also contain 0. The rTCA reductive branch pyruvate -> OAA -> malate -> succinate appears from the rules at 5e-8 / 9e-8 / 8e-9 M — three orders below og-02's curated 2 mM OAA — because pyruvate carboxylation at 1.4 mM CO2 sits at its equilibrium (dG'0 = -1.1 kJ/mol -> [OAA]/[pyruvate] = K [CO2] = 2e-3) rather than being driven irreversibly.

evidence.observed: universe 0 motifs, 14 persistent species, malate 8.8e-8 M; nulls 0/24; p = 1.0

findings.explanation: Every C-C bond-forming route is uphill at vent concentrations: reductive carboxylation of formate / acetate (+7.7 / +30.6 kJ/mol standard, +50 kJ/mol at the actual mM / 10 mM activities) and the aldehyde route (formate + H2 -> formaldehyde, +28 kJ/mol; [CH2O]eq = 3e-10 M). The universe is dissipative (0.88 W/L) but its flux is C1 reduction and pyruvate decay. Artifact: artifacts/motif_enrichment.json (arm phase1_feed).

findings.statement: With 10 mM formaldehyde added to the same feed, exactly one persistent autocatalytic motif emerges from the rules and is recovered post hoc: glycolaldehyde + CH2O -> glyceraldehyde -> dihydroxyacetone (+ CH2O) -> erythrulose -> erythrose -> 2 glycolaldehyde — the formose cycle (stoichiometric gain 2, dynamic gain 3.1 > 1, core of 5 species, 49 persistent species). 0 of 24 degree-preserving, (C,O)-matched null networks contain any motif: empirical p = 0.040 (1/25). The 6x6 ignition map (0.1-30 mM CH2O x 0.001-0.2/s washout; 3 nulls per cell, all 0) shows the motif only at formaldehyde >= 9.6 mM with washout >= 0.024/s, or 30 mM with washout >= 0.008/s (dynamic gain up to 18): at longer residence times the H2 reduction of formaldehyde and glycolaldehyde (k_reduce [H2] = 0.1/s) outruns the aldol propagation, and the gain falls below 1 again at 0.2/s where washout wins.

evidence.observed: universe 1 motif (gain 2, dynamic 3.1); nulls 0/24; p = 0.040; curated 1 motif (imposed)

findings.explanation: No rule names a cycle; the detector enumerates flux-carrying simple cycles with stoichiometric gain > 1 (Blokhuis 2020 type-I cores) from the doubling edges, identically for every class. The formose cycle closes through the retro-aldol of erythrose (the only doubling edge the chemistry provides at C <= 4). Artifact: artifacts/motif_enrichment.json (arm formose_feed, ignition_map).

findings.statement: Graded by the same detector, og-02's curated rTCA class shows one motif — the self-loop OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate — with dynamic gain 2.99, exactly its declared k_rtca [CO2] / k_wash, so the og-02 "autocatalytic gain" was a property written into the network, not an emergent one. The element ledger over its SBML finds the lumped turn creates 4 C, 8 H and 3 O per turn (6 C in, 10 C out), so og-02's net carbon throughput (6e-4 mol/s) counts carbon that was never fed. The curated class remains the fastest and richest in product, and the least conserving, of the three.

evidence.observed: element residual C 4 / H 8 / O 3 (max 8); detector gain 2.99 = declared 2.99

findings.explanation: og-02's finding og02-autocatalysis already said the motif was a curated lumped reaction; this study makes the consequence quantitative and machine-witnessed. studies.name: og-spatial-concentration
studies.title: Spatial Concentration: Does a Pore Make an Individual?
studies.question: Can vent pore physics concentrate a dilute vent feed strongly enough to form a persistent localized individual and ignite the reaction network productively — more than a matched well-mixed, non-concentrating control at identical feeds?

findings.statement: A favorable serpentinite pore (5 mm × 0.1 mm, ΔT 30 K, convective flow) clears the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime at accumulation Péclet 18.4 from the real thermophoretic + convective transport, with FVM flux conserved to machine epsilon. The corresponding fold-enrichment (reduced-model exp(Pe) ≈ 1e6–1e7, nominally ~9.6×10⁷) is an extrapolation whose magnitude is solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13 — the graded quantity is the Péclet, not the precise fold.

evidence.observed: favorable Pe_acc 18.4 (reduced-model fold-estimate ~1e6–1e7); FVM residual ~2e-14

findings.explanation: ThermophoreticTrapProcess solves the steady accumulation column; the Péclet is the resolved readout, while the fold-enrichment = exp(beta·L) is a reduced-model extrapolation. A FiPy↔FEniCS head-to-head cross-check finds the two solvers diverge by up to ~5.6 decades at Pe ≳ 13, so the extreme fold-magnitude is not treated as a precise resolved result.

findings.statement: The native pore-localization phase map (porosity × pore length) resolves localization as a bounded region, not a single favourable/open pair: the real trap localizes above the frontier (Péclet ≈ 18, reduced-model fold ≥ 1e6) at 25/144 grid points (~17%), enrichment rising with pore length, while an open pore (porosity→1) and a 10× shorter pore wash the feed through (no localization). The map is native to og-03's own trap readouts — it no longer borrows og-02's feed/washout axes. Localization (an individual forms vs washes through) is robust; the precise fold-magnitude in the high-Péclet interior is solver-sensitive (see limitations).

evidence.observed: 25/144 (17%) localized over (porosity 0.05–0.95 × pore length 5e-4–8e-3 m); open-pore does not concentrate (~1×), 10× shorter pore ~6× — both far below the frontier

findings.explanation: Enrichment rises with pore length and vanishes with confinement/openness — the dilution/localization boundary the campaign sought, read from the real FiPy accumulation solve and rendered as the pore-localization map (Decision view). The frontier LOCATION is robust; the fold-values deep in the high-Péclet interior are a reduced-model extrapolation.

findings.statement: At identical vent-posterior feeds (CO2/H2 = 1e-3), the concentrating pore ignites the network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4; connected; 17 persistent species) while the matched well-mixed nonconcentrating control does not (flux ~0; not connected) - spatial concentration is the only difference, so the pore causes the productive flux.

The C6 network - the one og-29 found ignites only at ~20x well-mixed feed - ignites directly in the demo pore at the vent-posterior base feed (porosity 0.88, pore-local 0.023 M), net carbon flux +4.49e-4, connected, 22 persistent species, while the matched well-mixed C6 control stays dead (flux +1.5e-9, not connected). C6 shows the same bounded-window behavior as C4 - a tight pore (porosity 0.70, pore-local 2.63 M) gives higher flux (+0.072) but the connectivity metric still degrades (network_connected = 0), so there is no flux-washout upper bound; the bound above is physically-implausible feeds plus connectivity-metric degradation, not flux loss.

A porosity sweep shows the pore's benefit is a bounded window, not a broad swath. Net carbon flux rises monotonically with confinement (no flux washout in the C4 network, even at extreme feeds), but the connectivity-defined ignition (og-29's network_connected metric) occupies a bounded, somewhat brittle porosity band (~0.80-0.90; pore-local ~0.01-0.2 M) - below it enrichment is sub-threshold, and above it the pore-local feeds become physically implausible (porosity 0.70 implies 2.6 M, 0.60 implies 36 M) while the connectivity metric itself degrades, flipping 1/0/1 across adjacent porosities at similar high flux. So ignition is met in a specific pore-geometry window, not robustly across geometry.

network_connected (og-29's ignition metric) is a BRITTLE proxy near threshold - at high feed the network stays carbon-fixing (flux high and monotone in enrichment) but loses broad connectivity (connected flips to 0), the same signal og-29 recorded as "washout" at x50 well-mixed, now seen to be connectivity-breadth loss rather than flux loss, consistent across C4/C6 and well-mixed/pore. This is a methodological caveat on the ignition metric only; it does NOT touch og-29's formose refutation, which rests on the thermodynamic mechanism and the coefficient-free seed-independence discriminator, not on connectivity.

This does double duty - it meets Gate B's own criterion (pore flux far exceeds the matched control) and resolves Gate A's open A1 feed-plausibility question: the ~20x well-mixed ignition gap is bridged by pore enrichment within the physical pore window, so a carbon-fixing network persists at vent-realistic feeds inside a pore (demonstrated on C4 and confirmed directly on C6).

studies.claim: Across fidelities, vent pore physics concentrates a dilute feed into a persistent localized individual and ignites the reaction network. Resolving diffusion, thermophoresis, adsorption, surface catalysis and advection, a bounded serpentinite pore clears the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime (accumulation Peclet 18.4) and localizes a persistent individual vs a well-mixed control (og-03, supported). At identical vent-posterior feeds the concentrating pore ignites the full network — net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species — while a matched well-mixed, non-concentrating control stays dark (og-30, canonical, supported); the C6 network og-29 found needs ~20x well-mixed feed ignites directly in the pore at base feed. The pore benefit is a bounded porosity window, and network_connected is a brittle proxy near threshold (both kept honest). og-30 does double duty: it meets Gate B and resolves Gate A1's feed-plausibility. Consolidated headline: supported — spatial concentration makes the individual and rescues ignition. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
