The corresponding fold-enrichment (reduced-model exp(Pe) ≈ 1e6–1e7, nominally ~9.6×10⁷) is an extrapolation whose magnitude is solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13 — the graded quantity is the Péclet, not the precise fold.

studies.name: og-energetics
studies.title: Proto-Energetics: Capture, Internalization, and Carrier Coupling
studies.question: Can a primitive chemical system capture geochemical free energy, internalize it under selection, and couple a specified carrier to perform endergonic work — and does any of it improve total throughput, or only persistence/robustness — each tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
methods: thioester carrier cycle with a closed free-energy ledger
matched gradient-only control (direct drive->work, no store)

findings.statement: An exergonic geochemical drive coupled to a pre-ATP thioester-class carrier builds and MAINTAINS a transferable energy currency under continuous endergonic load — the charged pool fills from empty and settles at ~39% of capacity, a spendable store held against discharge and hydrolysis. This is energetic bookkeeping (a carrier charged and spent), not a favourable reaction direction.

evidence.observed: charged fraction 0.00 -> 0.39 and held under load

findings.explanation: ProtoEnergyCurrencyProcess charges the carrier at the coupling efficiency when the drive ΔG clears the carrier bond, discharges it to endergonic work under load, and bleeds it by first-order hydrolysis; the steady charge is the balance of charging against the two drains.

findings.statement: Accounting the free energy by DESTINATION (a conserved ledger: input = useful work + stored + dissipated) shows ~47% of the tapped geochemical free energy is captured as transferable usable work at the favourable operating point, the remaining ~53% dissipated (uncoupled drive, discharge inefficiency, hydrolysis). Capture is not assumed — it is measured, bounded, and falls off smoothly as the coupling efficiency or the drive margin over the carrier bond declines.

evidence.observed: stored-work fraction 0.47 of input free energy; ledger residual ~1e-16 kJ/L

findings.explanation: The currency process emits the full ledger (input / work / stored / dissipated); the stored-work fraction is (work + stored)/input. Charging draws bond/efficiency of input per charged mole (the uncoupled remainder dissipated), so the captured fraction is bounded above by the coupling efficiency and reduced further by discharge loss and hydrolysis — rendered as the energy-provenance panel (Mechanism) and the capture landscape (Decision).

findings.statement: The currency collapses under either ablation — no coupling (efficiency -> 0) OR a drive ΔG below the carrier's high-energy bond — so capturing environmental free energy into a transferable store requires BOTH a coupling chemistry and a drive strong enough to clear the bond. The drive axis has a real thermodynamic gate, not merely a rate dependence; the Decision phase map is the bounded region where both conditions hold.

evidence.observed: favourable charged fraction 0.39 vs no-coupling 0.00 / no-drive 0.00

findings.explanation: A carrier can only be charged when the drive ΔG exceeds the bond energy (a weak drive cannot charge a high-energy carrier) and the coupling actually transfers it; below either threshold no store builds, so the viable region is bounded on both axes.

findings.statement: As the external geochemical gradient declines over the run, replicator selection drives the population from externally-driven (pump fraction ~0) to internalized gradient generation (pump fraction ~0.95) while persisting — the bioenergetic internalization is an evolutionary outcome, not a scripted upgrade.

evidence.observed: internalization 0.00 -> 0.95; survivors 1.0 at the collapsed gradient

findings.explanation: BioenergeticSelectionProcess replicator dynamics over a (permeability × pump) strategy grid with a Sojo leaky-membrane fitness; the declining gradient flips the winning strategy from leaky-external to tight-pump.

findings.statement: A weak pump cannot internalize — when the external gradient collapses, the weak-pump lineage goes extinct (survivors → 0) while the efficient-pump lineage persists. Internalization is only viable with a sufficiently efficient pump (the Sojo leaky-membrane constraint).

evidence.observed: efficient survivors 1.0 vs weak-pump survivors 0.0 at collapsed gradient

findings.explanation: Below a pump-efficiency threshold the internal-pump flux cannot beat its cost against the lost external coupling, so no strategy clears the survival floor.

findings.statement: Survival off the collapsing gradient is a bounded REGION, not two representative runs: the native (pump catalyst efficiency × gradient floor) Decision map survives at 185/196 points (~94%), with the low-floor / low-efficiency corner going extinct. The Sojo cost line (η ≈ 0.30 — where internal pumping clears its maintenance cost plus the survival floor) marks the internalize-or-die boundary, and internalization (pump fraction > 0.5) fills the efficient interior where the lineage truly OWNS its energy rather than riding the residual external gradient.

evidence.observed: 185/196 (94%) survive over (catalyst_efficiency 0.05–1.3 × gradient_floor 0.005–0.35); Sojo cost line η≈0.30; internalization 0.009–0.949 across the grid; operating point (η=1.0, floor=0.02) deep inside

findings.explanation: The bioenergetic_survival_map sweeps the real replicator loop under the declining gradient and reduces each point to the surviving fraction + the survives PASS mask; the Sojo efficiency floor is read from the selection process config ((survival_threshold + c_pump + c_base)/k_int). Rendered as the survival landscape + internalization map (Decision view).
findings.next_action: Sweep decline_rate / alternative collapse scenarios to test how the survival region deforms with the speed of gradient loss (og-05b).

findings.statement: Accounting the free energy by SOURCE (not just the net flux) shows the useful disequilibrium shifting from the external geochemical gradient to internally maintained power as the environment declines — the external share of the useful free energy peaks near ~82% early in the run, then collapses to ~1% as the gradient falls while the population persists. The organism comes to "own" its energy: the geochemical gradient becomes a resource it taps, not the scaffold that organizes it.

evidence.observed: external share of useful free energy peaks ~82% then falls to ~1% as external pmf 0.40 → 0.02 V; survivors 1.0, internalization → 0.95

findings.explanation: The selection process emits the population-mean provenance breakdown (external tap k_ext·pmf·P vs internal pump k_int·pump·eff·(1−P) vs maintenance cost); rendered as the stacked energy-provenance trajectory + the gradient-dependence curve (Mechanism view).

findings.statement: At the nominal membrane and gradient the thioester / acyl-phosphate store beats the passive baseline from coupling activity 0.10: its potential bond + RT ln(q/(1-q)) crosses the 30 kJ/mol load at q = 0.12 (29.6 kJ/mol) and work begins to flow; net power rises from the passive 1.95e-17 W to a maximum 2.17e-17 W at activity 0.8 (+2.1e-18 W, autonomy 0.24) and falls again at 1.0 as the machinery cost outgrows the pool-limited store. The class pays on 54 % of the whole grid and up to P_H 3.2e-6 m/s.

evidence.observed: a* = 0.10; autonomy 0.027 at a*, 0.262 at a = 1; best +2.1e-18 W at 0.8; ceiling 3.2e-6 m/s

findings.explanation: Charging at a x 1e-21 mol/s against hydrolysis 1e-4/s + carrier permeation 1e-4 x P_H x A/V (6e-4/s at 1e-6 m/s) sets q(a); the draw gate opens once mu(q) >= 30 kJ/mol, i.e. q >= 0.13 for a 35 kJ/mol bond. Artifact: artifacts/internalization_threshold_report.json (per_class.thioester_acyl_phosphate.nominal).

findings.statement: The pumped H+/Na+ gradient store never pays at fatty-acid-like leak: at P_H 1e-6 m/s its potential reaches only 6.5 kJ/mol at full activity (q = 0.11; the Na+ leak at 1e-3 x P_H x A/V = 6e-3/s outruns the pump), so it draws no work and costs 5e-18 W of maintenance (net 1.45e-17 vs passive 1.95e-17 W). At P_H 1e-8 m/s it pays from activity 0.5 with autonomy 0.97 — the Sojo-2014 tradeoff inside one individual: the same leak that feeds the external tap drains the ion store, so owning a gradient needs a membrane tight to Na+.

evidence.observed: pays on 4 % of the grid; ceiling P_H 1e-8 m/s; potential 6.5 kJ/mol at nominal, autonomy 0.97 at 1e-8

findings.explanation: The ion store's leak is the only leak law tied to the membrane permeability (ratio x P_H); the chemical carriers leak by hydrolysis independent of the membrane and by a 10-100x smaller permeation, so only the ion class has a permeability ceiling two decades below the others.

findings.statement: A polyphosphate store (20 kJ/mol per bond, 100x slower hydrolysis than the thioester) never beats the passive baseline on the grid: clearing a 30 kJ/mol load needs RT ln(q/(1-q)) >= 10 kJ/mol, i.e. q > 0.98, and the drive turnover against carrier permeation charges it only to q = 0.69 (22 kJ/mol) at full activity. Kinetic stability does not substitute for bond energy once the load is fixed.

evidence.observed: pays on 0 % of the grid; potential 22.1 kJ/mol at q = 0.69 (a = 1, nominal); autonomy 0 everywhere at nominal

findings.explanation: The phosphorylation-potential logic of Buckel & Thauer made per-individual; the class would pay against a lower load (expert question).

findings.statement: The reduced-metal store charged by the Fe(II)-disproportionation drive sits at the load: its potential is pinned at 29.3-29.9 kJ/mol (q 0.62-0.67) once the draw gate half-opens, so it pays only from activity 0.8 (+1.8e-19 W, autonomy 0.17 at a*, 0.21 at full activity) and on 18 % of the grid, with a ceiling at the nominal P_H 1e-6 m/s.

evidence.observed: a* = 0.80; autonomy 0.17 at a*; best +1.8e-19 W at 1.0; pays on 18 % of the grid

findings.explanation: With a 28 kJ/mol effective transfer the store must be two-thirds charged to clear the load; the result depends directly on the hypothetical bond and drive numbers the package flags.

findings.statement: With the external gradient collapsed to the og-05 floor (0.02 V) the passive baseline keeps 1.7e-18 W; the thioester (3.7e-18 W, autonomy 0.79) and Fe-redox (1.9e-18 W, autonomy 0.74) individuals keep a larger positive budget drawn mostly from their store, while the ion-gradient and polyphosphate individuals go negative (-3.3e-18 W). The per-individual autonomy published by og-05's selection loop from the same power terms is 0.99 at its collapsed gradient (its population-mean pump fraction: 0.95).

evidence.observed: collapsed gradient, a = 1, P_H 1e-6: thioester net 3.7e-18 W / autonomy 0.79; fe_redox 1.9e-18 / 0.74; h_na and polyphosphate -3.3e-18 / 0

findings.explanation: Autonomy = internal / (internal + external) is the same readout for one individual here and for og-05's population; the switch of og-05's gates to it is recorded as a decision.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: on all 990 runs the cumulative identity in + E0 - work - dissipated = E(t) holds to 1.3e-14 relative, the second-law margin never goes below rounding (-1e-26 J against ~1e-13 J of intake), the per-tick dissipation is never negative and the capture efficiency never exceeds 0.30 (the passive tap's conversion; the internal classes capture less of their gross intake). The vg-data package energy_currencies carries 0 measured, 1 calibrated, 8 inferred, 3 extrapolated and 12 hypothetical parameters with no unsourced non-hypothetical entry.

evidence.observed: residual max 1.3e-14; margin min -1e-26 J; dissipation min 0; efficiency max 0.30; audit 0/1/8/3/12

findings.explanation: The store's free energy is an exact function of its charge (ideal mixing relative to the resting charge; capacitor for the ion gradient), so every tick's flows are differences of that function and the ledger closes by construction — the inequality is then a real check on the sign of each flow.

findings.statement: The thioester carrier pays on DIP-PERSISTENCE, not total throughput. Under a declining geochemical drive with the free-energy ledger closing (max |budget_residual| ~9e-19, no hidden inflow), the carrier does useful work through the dip (0.030) where the matched gradient-only control starves (0.006); but total useful work is NOT improved (carrier 0.256 vs gradient-only 0.282) - the carrier time-shifts banked energy into the dip and loses some to hydrolysis, and gates activation at the bond so it does not capture the above-bond surplus (true even at zero hydrolysis). So the carrier buys gradient-dip resilience, not raw throughput - the same persistence-not-throughput motif as Gate B (pore) and Gate C (membrane). Verdict qualified. Guardrail: the carrier funds endergonic work for the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network, not autocatalysis.

The full free-energy ledger (activation / use / hydrolysis / stored) closes to machine precision in both arms (max |budget_residual| ~9e-19), so the dip-persistence benefit is real accounting, not an unbalanced source - there is no hidden energy inflow. A ledger that only closed with a hidden inflow would be a reported failure, not a pass.

Carrier chemistry is one specified thioester cycle (Option B, tied to the og-12 rebuild); the total-work cost/benefit is a k_hydrolyze window - here the carrier does not beat gradient-only on total at any tested leak rate (including zero), so the benefit is strictly dip-persistence. The alternative carrier (acyl-phosphate) and a microkinetic enzyme-free resolution are the gold-standard follow-on (og-35a) that would re-test the energy benefit under resolved, multi-carrier chemistry rather than one lumped cycle.

studies.claim: Across fidelities, a protocell's energetics buy robustness/persistence, not raw throughput. A primitive carrier captures geochemical free energy into a transferable store with a closing ledger (proto-energetics arm, supported); a compartment internalizes electrochemical work under selection and pays for it within a Sojo-bounded survival region (internalization arm, supported); which coupling chemistry pays is structure-sensitive and membrane-leak-dependent (5-class alt arm, supported, classes agree ~46%); and a specified thioester carrier does useful work through a gradient dip where gradient-only starves but does NOT improve total useful work (sharpened Gate-E arm, og-35, qualified). The consolidated headline is bounded by that sharpest arm: qualified, dip-persistence not throughput. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.

derived.insight: An exergonic geochemical drive coupled to a pre-ATP thioester-class carrier builds and MAINTAINS a transferable energy currency under continuous endergonic load — the charged pool fills from empty and settles at ~39% of capacity, a spendable store held against discharge and hydrolysis. This is energetic bookkeeping (a carrier charged and spent), not a favourable reaction direction.

studies.name: og-heredity
studies.title: Chemical Heredity and Selection
studies.question: Does the protocell transmit an inherited chemical difference that carries selectable information at a feasible cost and produces a reproducible fitness difference against a no-inheritance control — and at what fidelity (compositional vs template)?
methods: fitness grounded in study-32/33 retention -> division-rate coupling
Wright-Fisher selection vs a matched no-inheritance null
vasas-2010 evolvability caveat tested, not assumed

findings.statement: A high-fidelity heredity module (RNA-like, 30-mer, per-site fidelity 0.99 → whole-sequence Q=0.74) retains functional information (C/(C+E)=0.62) and achieves net-positive lineage fitness (0.38) after its replication cost, outscoring the non-heritable control whose function degrades away.

evidence.observed: RNA-like fitness 0.38 (retention 0.62) vs non-heritable ~0

findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner quasispecies ODE; above the Eigen error threshold correct templates outreplicate the mutational error tail (Eigen 1971).

findings.statement: Heredity modules rank by an evidence-based head-to-head — RNA-like (0.38) beats the cheaper, lower-fidelity peptide module (0.24), and both beat non-inheritance — while a module below the error threshold (per-site 0.90 × 30-mer, Q=0.04) suffers the error catastrophe (retention 0, fitness −0.10).

evidence.observed: RNA-like 0.38 > peptide 0.24; low-fidelity retention 0, fitness -0.10

findings.explanation: Whole-sequence fidelity Q = per_site_fidelity^length sets the threshold; longer high-fidelity polymers retain more information but cost more to replicate.

findings.statement: An agent-based LINEAGE model (individuals inherit a chemical phenotype at fission into a real tree) reproduces the Eigen error threshold (the imposed Q=fidelity^length relation) as a functional-persistence boundary in (per-site fidelity × length) space — AND shows that heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity template — compositional (GARD) and template-focused hybrid heredity persist at functional-persistence ~0.88 (seed-robust — 0.878±0.005 across the 5 graded seeds, 8/8 in a wider sweep) INDEPENDENT of length, where a long low-fidelity template collapses; the non-heritable control loses the parent↔offspring correlation (realized heritability ~0.04–0.11 vs 0.92–0.99 for the heritable modules) and crashes to ~5 individuals.

evidence.observed: compositional persistence 0.878±0.005 across 5 graded seeds (heritability 0.92), hybrid ~0.88 (0.92) — length-independent; template needs Q=fidelity^length above threshold; non-heritable heritability ~0.04–0.11, collapses every seed

findings.explanation: Coarse-grained agent-based reproduction with explicit fidelity/cost/competition. Template inheritance ratchets (Eigen 1971, no back-mutation) so a long low-fidelity template loses information; compositional inheritance drifts by multinomial fission of an autocatalytic composition (GARD, Segré 2000) — length-independent, so it escapes the length catastrophe. The realized heritability (offspring↔parent φ slope) separates true inheritance from the non-heritable control.

findings.statement: With heredity attached, parent and offspring phenotypes share information in every class — rna_like 1.46 +/- 0.10 bit, mineral_state 2.24 +/- 0.14, network 0.53 +/- 0.06, hybrid 0.49 +/- 0.03, compositional 0.47 +/- 0.03, peptide 0.14 +/- 0.22 (6 seeds; MI net of the permutation null, phenotype resolution 0.05) with realised heritability 0.45-1.0 — while every unattached control, whose daughters re-form their heritable material de novo from the same pool at the same price, transmits 0.00 bit with heritability < 0.01. Four classes (rna_like, network, compositional, hybrid) pass the strict pre-registered rule (MI converged on every seed, >= 0.1 bit, >= 0.05 bit above control); peptide fails because at q_p = 0.7 its whole-copy fidelity 0.06 sits below the Eigen floor 1/sigma = 0.33 and its function is lost before the estimator can converge; mineral_state fails convergence on one seed (bootstrap SE 0.15 bit) because its function decays as layer-copy errors accumulate at the nominal budget.

evidence.observed: 4/6 classes pass; controls 0.00 bit in every class; rna_like 1.46 bit, h2 0.93

findings.explanation: The information is measured on the phenotype (the function the heritable state confers), binned at a 5 % resolution so variation selection cannot see is not counted, bias-corrected (Miller-Madow) and reported net of a 20-permutation null; the convergence check is a time-ordered prefix ladder plus a bootstrap SE. Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (classes.*.attached / .control).

findings.statement: Bits per joule span 3.8 decades across the six classes: mineral_state 5.4e19 (0 quanta, 0.1 quanta-equivalent per growth unit), network 1.3e18 (1 amino acid + 1 quantum per molecule), compositional 4.3e17 (1 amphiphile, 0 quanta), rna_like 4.9e16 (30 nucleotides + 30 quanta per copy), hybrid 2.5e16, peptide 9.0e15. Per offspring, rna_like spends 3.0e-17 J and 150 precursor molecules for 1.46 bit; network 4.2e-19 J and 4 molecules for 0.53 bit. Among classes whose estimate converged on every seed the Pareto front of (bits up, energy down) is {network, rna_like}; mineral_state (2.24 bit at 4.1e-20 J) would dominate both axes if certified.

evidence.observed: span 3.8 decades in bits/J; Pareto {network, rna_like}; cheapest and richest = mineral_state (uncertified)

findings.explanation: Costs are integer molecule and quantum counts drawn from the shared budgets by every copy event and converted with the package's 30 kJ/mol quantum and precursor energy equivalents (hypothetical); the InformationLedgerProcess integrates them against births and audits the store exactly (residual <= 3.1e-14 on 252 runs). Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (frontier, ledger).

findings.statement: og-06's "heredity need not presume RNA" survives as a class-substitution result, but only in one currency: among certified classes the best non-RNA class (network) carries 0.36x the RNA-like bits per offspring and 26x its bits per joule; compositional carries 0.32x and 9x. Templated heredity takes over from the organic attractor classes exactly where the Eigen floor admits it — rna_like at q >= 0.967 (Q = q^30 = 0.37 > 1/sigma = 0.33) carries 1.45 bit against their 0.5; at q <= 0.95 it is not attached and transmits nothing. The template never overtakes the mineral class within the swept range.

evidence.observed: nonrna bits/J fraction 26 (network); nonrna bits fraction 0.36; rna_like overtakes organic classes from q = 0.967

findings.explanation: og-06 graded persistence of function; this study grades transmitted bits against their price, so the two halves of og-06's claim separate: the template is the richest organic carrier, the attractors are the cheapest. Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (gates.nonrna_bits_fraction, gates.nonrna_bits_per_joule_fraction, fidelity_transition).

findings.statement: With the HeredityAttachmentStep deciding, compositional, network and mineral heredity attach from 3 % of the nominal matched budget (every feed and the power scaled together), hybrid from 30 %, rna_like only at the full budget (precursor ratio 0.74 even then, latched at the first full tick) and peptide at none (fidelity ratio 0.17): mean attached-fraction span low-to-high budget 1.0 over the five attachable classes. The step's budget thresholds (10 copies per individual, energy margin 1) are hypothetical and swept; its fidelity floor is Eigen's Q >= 1/sigma. Two budget-driven reversals appear in the map: the mineral class's function collapses as the budget rises (more layers grown per generation means more copy errors: 0.93 at 3 % to 0.15 at 100 %) and the network class's information vanishes at 3x (every core saturates its niche, so there is no variation to transmit).

evidence.observed: attachment span 1.0; attach-from budgets 0.03 / 0.03 / 0.03 / 0.3 / 1.0 / never

findings.explanation: FMP 2.5 attachment as a lineage-level flag: before it, daughters re-form heritable material de novo and pay for it; after it, copies are partitioned at fission. Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (attachment_map).

findings.statement: The fidelity transition reproduces the error threshold at the agent level with exact stochastic dynamics: rna_like keeps function only from q = 0.967 (settled mean function 0.22; 0.55 at q = 0.99) and is refused and non-functional at q <= 0.95; peptide needs q_p >= 0.90 over 8 sites; the 8-site hybrid template attaches from q = 0.90; the mineral pattern from p_m <= 0.005 per bit per layer (function 0.10 there, 0.71 at 0.001). The attachment step's analytic floor and the simulated loss of function agree at every swept point.

evidence.observed: rna_like attaches from q = 0.967; peptide from 0.90; hybrid from 0.90; mineral from p_m = 0.005

findings.explanation: Each template's own copy rate rises with its function (the master sequence copies sigma-fold faster), daughters inherit a random half of the parent's molecules, and bulk growth carries the cell-level selection; the common sigmoid landscape makes a 1-2-error neighbour functional and the tail not. Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (fidelity_transition).

findings.statement: The vg-data package inheritance_budgets carries 39 parameters: 1 measured (the R18 polymerase ribozyme's 96.7 % per-site fidelity), 6 inferred, 8 extrapolated and 24 hypothetical, none unsourced; the mineral class's defect-copy error — the number that makes it dominate the frontier — is hypothetical with no measured anchor, and the attachment thresholds are hypothetical and swept.

evidence.observed: audit counts measured 1 / calibrated 0 / inferred 6 / extrapolated 8 / hypothetical 24; unsourced []

findings.explanation: The honesty indicator; the frontier's headline ordering rests on the hypothetical precursor energy equivalents and the mineral copy error, which is why it is reported as a frontier under stated costs, not a ranking.

findings.statement: There IS selectable chemical heredity (not the vasas-2010 null). Across 8 seeds x 40 generations at equal feeds, an inherited network-composition difference yields a reproducible parent-offspring fitness correlation (mean +0.949) far above the matched no-inheritance control (-0.018; permutation p=0.0001). Fitness is grounded in the real study-32/33 coupling (composition -> membrane retention -> standing pool -> division rate), so the correlation reflects a genuine mechanistic fitness consequence. Guardrail: selection acts on the inherited composition of the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network, not autocatalysis.

The inheriting population shifts composition measurably under selection (mean shift +0.551 toward higher-retention / longer-chain composition) while the matched no-inheritance control drifts (-0.004; permutation p=0.0002). Selection acts because both heritable variation and a reproducible fitness difference are present - the vasas-2010 evolvability caveat was tested (declared heritable variance sigma=0.03, not tuned) and the population shifts rather than drifts.

Heredity is carried by inherited NETWORK COMPOSITION (Option B, compositional / GARD-style), with the vasas-2010 evolvability caveat TESTED, not assumed - compositional inheritance carried enough selectable variance here for selection to act. Template copying (Option A, og-34a) is the higher-fidelity follow-on that would re-test selectable heredity under a copying mechanism, especially where compositional inheritance might prove too low-variance in other regimes.

studies.claim: Across fidelities, an inherited chemical difference in the protocell is transmitted and selectable. Competing modules show heredity need not presume a long RNA template and that compositional / hybrid inheritance escapes the Eigen length catastrophe (og-06, supported); the information-per-cost frontier resolves which mechanisms transmit heritable bits per joule, attachment conditional on budget (og-06-alt, supported); and a daughter-inherited compositional difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference — parent-offspring correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control, with the population shifting under selection (og-34, qualified, canonical). Consolidated headline: qualified, compositional inheritance; template copying is the og-34a follow-up. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.

derived.insight: A high-fidelity heredity module (RNA-like, 30-mer, per-site fidelity 0.99 → whole-sequence Q=0.74) retains functional information (C/(C+E)=0.62) and achieves net-positive lineage fitness (0.38) after its replication cost, outscoring the non-heritable control whose function degrades away.

studies.name: og-adv-generic-nonequilibrium
studies.title: The Adversarial Control
studies.question: Are the campaign's positive gates genuinely dependent on vent-specific mechanisms, or would any generic driven nonequilibrium chemistry pass them? It should not.
proposed_mechanisms: the same real og-01/02/03 composites with vent features (H2, Fe/Ni/S catalyst, pore concentration) disabled
proposed_models_methods: flat gradient, inert surface, open pore, well-mixed — a generic abiotic nonequilibrium mixture
re-run the og-01/02/03 behavior-test gates unchanged and require rejection

contract.note: Reuses the og-01 carbon-fixation composite's ProcessContract (typed ports + conservation predicates); the control is a parameterization, so it inherits the same audited face.

resolved_uncertainties: The og-01/02/03 gates are vent-specific and falsifiable — a feature-ablated generic control is rejected by all five while the vent passes all five.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether broader non-vent scenario families (atmospheric/impact/surface chemistries) are also rejected.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Add a second adversarial family (e.g. an atmospheric-spark or impact-plume control) and confirm the gates reject it too.

findings.statement: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. Running the real og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates fall below threshold — net C-flux 4e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; formate ~0 vs 50 mM; protometabolic throughput 3e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; accumulation Péclet 0.26 vs 18; enrichment 1.3 (generic) vs the vent clearing the ≥10⁶-fold gate (a reduced-model magnitude, solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13; see og-03) — the tightest by 1.8 decades. The vent passes all five.

evidence.observed: min rejection margin 1.84 decades (tightest gate: og-03 accumulation Péclet, generic 0.26 < 18); all 5 gates reject generic, vent passes all 5

findings.explanation: The vent features are PARAMETERS on the same real composites, so the control is a parameterization of the vent models, not a hand-tuned mock. No dissolved H2 → no CO2 reduction; no Fe/Ni/S interface → no abiotic carbon fixation; an open pore → no thermophoretic concentration.

findings.statement: The gates are vent-specific detectors, not generic nonequilibrium detectors — the vent passes where the control fails on each of the five gates. A PASS therefore certifies the vent mechanism (sustained H2 + Fe/Ni/S catalysis + pore concentration), falsifying the "the gates just measure any driven chemistry" objection.

evidence.observed: vent passes 5/5 gates; generic control fails 5/5 — pass-where-control-fails on every gate

findings.explanation: Falsification exposure for the whole investigation — the headline claims would be hollow if a feature-ablated control cleared the same bars. It does not.

findings.statement: Building the control exposed a latent control-integrity bug — catalyst_active=0 was silently swallowed by process-bigraph's is_empty(Float, 0.0) and refilled with the default, so the no-catalyst control (here AND in og-01's cross-run gate) secretly ran WITH full catalyst. Clamping to 1e-6 honors the control; og-01's gates still pass (9/9 + both cross-run) with the now-truthful control.

evidence.observed: no-catalyst formate dropped from ~0.014 mM (catalyst silently on) to ~2e-8 mM (honored); og-01 still PASS

findings.explanation: Same gotcha as og-04's mix_fraction=0; a control parameter set to exactly 0.0 must be clamped to a negligible floor so the ablation is real.

studies.claim: Run with the vent's characteristic features ablated - no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface and no pore concentration - the same real composites fail all five discriminating gates (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Peclet and enrichment), while the vent configuration passes all five, with the tightest rejection margin about 1.8 decades. This is a falsification control: a pass elsewhere in the campaign certifies the vent mechanism rather than simply any nonequilibrium chemistry producing activity. The extreme enrichment magnitude itself is a reduced-model, solver-sensitive figure and is used only as a pass/fail discriminator here.

biological_validation.basis: The generic non-vent control is rejected by every discriminating gate, while the vent passes all five — the gates are vent-specific.

explanatory_gain.basis: Demonstrates falsification exposure for the whole investigation — the gates could have passed a feature-ablated control and did not.

derived.insight: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. Running the real og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates fall below threshold — net C-flux 4e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; formate ~0 vs 50 mM; protometabolic throughput 3e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; accumulation Péclet 0.26 vs 18; enrichment 1.3 (generic) vs the vent clearing the ≥10⁶-fold gate (a reduced-model magnitude, solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13; see og-03) — the tightest by 1.8 decades. The vent passes all five.

studies.name: og-nutrient-bottlenecks
studies.title: Nutrient Bottlenecks: Nitrogen and Phosphorus Keep Pace with Carbon
studies.question: Do the two non-carbon nutrient bottlenecks clear at the vent — does reduced nitrogen (ammonium) keep pace with carbon fixation, and does reactive phosphorus co-concentrate with carbon rather than precipitate — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?

findings.statement: FeS-mediated reduction of nitrate through nitrite sustains a standing ammonium pool (~1.0 mM) with an H2 reductant at ~80 C, the first reduced nitrogen the chemistry needs.

evidence.observed: settled NH4+ ~1.0 mM; peak production ~4.2e-5 mol/s

findings.explanation: A real ReducedNitrogenProductionProcess reduces NO3- -> NO2- -> NH4+ gated by H2 availability, an FeS temperature window and catalyst activity.

findings.statement: At the favourable operating point reduced-N production keeps pace with the carbon-fixation demand — the C:N supply ratio settles at ~5.0, within the viable (near-Redfield) band.

evidence.observed: settled C:N supply ratio ~5.0 (viable band 1-8)

findings.explanation: The C:N supply ratio = carbon demand / reduced-N production; reductive amination draws ammonium into amino-acid precursors at a rate set by the carbon demand.

findings.statement: Ammonium is present only with BOTH an active FeS catalyst and an H2 reductant — it collapses to <1 µM when either is removed (each is necessary, not merely correlated).

evidence.observed: favourable NH4+ ~1.0 mM; no-FeS and no-H2 controls <1 µM

findings.statement: A parameter sweep over (nitrate supply x FeS activity) maps where reduced N keeps pace with carbon versus where nitrogen becomes limiting FIRST. Reduced N keeps pace only where the nitrate feed is sufficient AND the mineral is active; starving the feed drives the settled C:N supply ratio from ~5 to ~47 (nitrogen limiting), so the decision is a bounded region, not a representative run.

evidence.observed: favourable C:N ~5.0 (keeps pace) vs scarce-nitrate C:N ~47 (limiting); keeps-pace boundary at C:N = 8

findings.explanation: 16x16 sweep of the real open-flow reduced-nitrogen reactor (nitrate supply 2e-6-1e-4 M/s x FeS activity 0.05-1.0) reduced to the settled C:N supply ratio + a keeps-pace mask, rendered as the nitrogen phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_nitrogen_grid.py.

findings.statement: Nitrogen mass is conserved by construction — every internal reaction conserves N atoms, so the per-step accounting residual stays at ~1e-20 M (the matter-accounting invariant).

evidence.observed: max |n_mass_residual| ~1e-20 M over the run

findings.statement: In the favorable thermal-gradient pore, reactive-P formation outpaces the precipitation/adsorption loss — net reactive-P availability settles positive (~+1.8e-6 mol/s) and reactive P accumulates to ~94% of the supplied phosphorus while only ~6% precipitates. A bounded local window exists where reactive P is produced faster than it is lost.

evidence.observed: ~+1.8e-6 mol/s net availability; reactive P ~94% of supply; ~6% precipitated

findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner ODE P-speciation network: enrichment enters condensation as enr^2 and activation as enr, while precipitation is first-order in phosphate, so a concentrated pore tips phosphate's fate toward the reactive route.

findings.statement: The SAME real og-03 thermophoretic pore that lifts a dilute carbon feed across the ignition threshold (species-agnostic Soret + convection trap) co-concentrates phosphate: at the pore's enrichment the P reactive-availability is positive and the enrichment exceeds the carbon co-concentration floor (~10×). C and P co-concentrate in one pore regime — reported as an overlap boundary, not a fitted target.

evidence.observed: og-03 pore enrichment >> 10× carbon co-concentration floor; P reactive-availability positive at that enrichment

findings.explanation: The thermophoretic trap enrichment depends on the Soret coefficient and pore geometry, not on the solute identity, so the pore that concentrates carbon concentrates phosphate; coupling it to the P-speciation network shows reactive P becomes available in the same regime.

findings.statement: The feature ablation is decisive — an open pore / no thermal gradient (enrichment = 1) collapses reactive-P availability: net availability goes negative and ~96% of phosphorus precipitates to the mineral sink. Phosphate precipitates/adsorbs before it is chemically useful unless the pore concentrates it first.

evidence.observed: favorable net ~+1.8e-6 (6% precipitated) vs open-pore net < 0 (~96% precipitated)

findings.explanation: Without enrichment the condensation/activation fluxes (enr-gated) fall below the first-order precipitation loss, so phosphate drains into mineral-bound P — the phosphorus bottleneck made explicit.

findings.statement: A 16×16 sweep over (phosphate source × pore/thermal enrichment) maps where reactive P is available, not just that it is at one point. Reactive-P availability is bounded by the net-availability threshold (production = loss) on the enrichment axis; the PASS region is where that threshold is crossed AND the enrichment co-concentrates carbon (right of the ~10× carbon floor). Below the threshold phosphate precipitates before it is useful.

evidence.observed: reactive-P pool ranges ~0 to ~1 mM across the (source × enrichment) plane (~94% of supply, ~94 µM, at the favorable 1e-4 M point); availability bounded by net=0 and the carbon co-concentration floor

findings.explanation: 16×16 sweep of the real libRoadRunner composite reduced to the settled reactive-P pool, net availability and precipitated fraction; rendered as the reactive-P availability phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_phosphorus_availability_grid.py.

studies.claim: Neither of the two non-carbon nutrient bottlenecks blocks the vent pathway. Reduced nitrogen is produced as ammonium that is sustained and keeps pace with carbon fixation (setting a viable C:N), with the feature-ablation null producing none and nitrogen mass conserved (nitrogen arm, supported). Reactive phosphorus is available and co-concentrates with carbon in the pore, with an open-pore no-enrichment control showing no enrichment and P mass conserved (phosphorus arm, supported). Headline verdict supported; every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.

derived.insight: FeS-mediated reduction of nitrate through nitrite sustains a standing ammonium pool (~1.0 mM) with an H2 reductant at ~80 C, the first reduced nitrogen the chemistry needs.

studies.name: og-01-cal-electrochemistry
studies.title: The Vent Wall as a Galvanic Cell: Which Limitation Stops Carbon Fixation, and Do the Model Classes Agree?
studies.question: Treating the vent wall as an explicit galvanic cell (Nernst potentials, Butler-Volmer kinetics), do the empirical and the electrochemical model classes agree on which limitation (thermodynamic, electrical, catalytic, transport) stops carbon fixation across the region both call favorable - the pre-registered test being at least 80% agreement on the limitation label?
proposed_mechanisms: A: empirical gated kinetics (og-01) with the gradient efficiency derived from the wall circuit
B: the wall as a galvanic cell — Nernst potentials, Butler-Volmer kinetics, ohmic mineral + ionic path, faradaic split
C: adsorbate microkinetics with site coverage and passivation (deferred; pixi)
proposed_models_methods: carbon_fixation face with the model class as a categorical sweep axis
Nernst + Butler-Volmer galvanic-cell solve (Brent) per tick; Koutecky-Levich transport limits; Bruggeman ionic path
Loss-fraction partition of the fresh-fluid emf -> limitation label per point; cross-class agreement + confusion
Charge + electron ledger (Kirchhoff residual, faradaic efficiency <= 1, current-voltage residual)

conditions.name: loss_partition
conditions.expr: loss_thermodynamic + loss_electrical + loss_catalytic + loss_transport == 1 while current flows (butler_volmer)

contract.note: Ports are canonical vg_* fields (viva_genesis/schemas.py PORT_TO_CANONICAL); every carbon_fixation class is face-checked at build (models.assert_face).

resolved_uncertainties: gradient_efficiency can be derived from the wall's circuit; an insulating wall (< 1e-6 S/m) collapses it as a consequence.
The charge + electron ledger closes for both classes; faradaic efficiency is bounded.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the cell is really activation-limited at Lost-City-like conditions (depends on the exchange currents; the per-condition Altair data would pin them).
Whether site coverage and passivation (microkinetic class) move the catalytic label toward transport at high current.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Run the microkinetic class under pixi; attach the Altair-2025 time courses and fit the exchange currents; re-evaluate the agreement gate with three classes.
Re-run og-01's gates with model_carbon_fixation = butler_volmer as the default class and report the parameter-robust vs structure-sensitive regions of its phase map.

findings.statement: Every one of the 375 grid points carries a limitation label in both runnable classes (coverage 1.00; 0 failed runs). Butler-Volmer: catalytic 226, electrical 149, transport 0, thermodynamic 0. Empirical: transport 147, catalytic 117, electrical 108, thermodynamic 3.

evidence.observed: label coverage 1.00 (empirical), 1.00 (butler_volmer); 0/750 failed points

findings.explanation: The Butler-Volmer class partitions the fresh-fluid emf into product back-pressure (thermodynamic), ohmic drop (electrical), activation overpotential (catalytic) and concentration overpotential (transport) — four fractions that sum to one while current flows — and takes the largest (a cathode sending most electrons to H2 is catalytic / selectivity-limited). The empirical class publishes the headroom of each of its multiplicative gates (1 - feasible, 1 - drive(pmf), 1 - catalyst x Ni gain, 1 - availability). Artifact: artifacts/electrochemistry_mechanism_map.json.

findings.statement: The pre-registered failure-mode-attributed gate fails: on the 78 points both classes call favorable the labels agree on 37 (0.47); overall 168/375 (0.45). The confusion is systematic, not noise — every Butler-Volmer favorable point is catalytic (93/93), while the empirical class calls 47 of its favorable points electrical and 28 transport. Agreement is high only where the physics is unambiguous: 0.81 at 1e-9 S/m (both: electrical) and 0.67-0.68 at H2 >= 1.4e-4 M; it collapses to 0.01 at 1 uM H2, where the empirical Michaelis constant (1e-4 M) declares transport limitation that the cell never reaches (the limiting current stays above the activation-limited current at these exchange currents).

evidence.observed: label agreement 0.474 on 78 favorable-both points (gate >= 0.8); 0.448 overall; favorability structure agreement 0.65

findings.explanation: The empirical rate law's drive(pmf) = pmf / (pmf + 0.08 V) lumps the delivered gradient (electrical) and the electrode kinetics (catalytic) into one saturating term, so its "electrical" headroom in the favorable region is what the Butler-Volmer class resolves as activation overpotential. Paired class differences on identical points: loss_transport d = 1.77, loss_thermodynamic d = 0.68 (discriminating); loss_electrical, loss_catalytic and gradient_efficiency |d| < 0.5 (not discriminating). decision_discipline flags the attribution as structure-sensitive.

findings.statement: Under explicit electrochemistry the alkaline-vent cell is catalytically (activation) limited everywhere the wall conducts: at the nominal point (pH 9.5 | 6.0, 5 mM H2, 2 mM CO2, 100 C, 1e-3 S/m, Ni3Fe) the anode + cathode activation overpotentials take 0.996 of the 0.49 V fresh-fluid emf, the ohmic drop 0.002 and transport 0.001, at j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2 with faradaic efficiency 0.92 to carbon. Throughput rises only ~40x across the whole (pH x H2) plane (74 mV per pH unit, (RT/2F) ln10 per decade of H2) because the current scales with the exchange current, not the driving force. The electrical regime appears below ~1e-6 S/m (ohmic drop > activation), where the circuit-derived gradient efficiency is 0.01-0.42.

evidence.observed: nominal losses: catalytic 0.996, electrical 0.002, transport 0.001, thermodynamic 0.0; j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2; FE 0.92; gradient_efficiency 0.01 / 0.42 / 0.98 / 1.00 at 1e-9 / 1e-7 / 1e-5 / 1e-3 S/m

findings.explanation: Exchange currents calibrated to the Altair-2025 current window (j0_co2 1e-5, j0_h2 5e-5, j0_her 2.5e-6 A/m^2 at Ni3Fe, 100 C) are small, so the Butler-Volmer branches need ~0.2-0.3 V each to carry 1e-3 A/m^2; the mineral + ionic path drops microvolts unless the wall is an insulator. This is a prediction under the calibration, not a measurement: the per-condition Altair currents are not yet attached.

findings.statement: The Butler-Volmer class's settled current density lies inside the Altair-2025 window (1e-5 .. 1e-2 A/m^2, i.e. ~10 nA .. 10 uA on the cm^2-scale interface) at the canonical operating point and on 79.7% of the grid (range 1.4e-7 .. 3.0e-3 A/m^2; the points below the window are the insulating walls). Selectivity to carbon products stays 0.76-1.00.

evidence.observed: canonical j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2; grid fraction in window 0.797; FE 0.76-1.00

findings.explanation: Reproduction-tier check against the calibration window (vg-data electrochemical_interface.observations.cell_current_density); the window is the dossier summary, not a per-condition fit.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: the ChargeLedgerProcess closes on all 750 mechanism-map runs and on the 120-tick canonical run — Kirchhoff residual |anode - (carbon + H2 evolution)| / anode <= 1.7e-13 (0.0 for the empirical class), faradaic efficiency never above 1 (max 1 + 1e-13), circuit residual <= 8.5e-9. The ledger caught a real bookkeeping gap during the build (on insulating walls the trace ocean-side H2 oxidising at the cathode co-supplies electrons), which is now counted explicitly.

evidence.observed: charge residual <= 1.7e-13; FE max 1.0000000000001; iv residual <= 8.5e-9; 0/750 failed

studies.claim: No. The two classes agree on the dominant-limitation label on only 47% of the favorable region, below the pre-registered 80% gate, so the gate fails and the attribution is structure-sensitive. Under explicit electrochemistry the vent cell is activation (catalyst) limited everywhere the wall conducts and electrical only below ~1e-6 S/m, but the empirical rate law's single Michaelis drive term lumps electrical and catalytic limitation together and invents a transport limit the cell physics never reaches. The electrochemistry itself is real, calibrated to the Altair-2025 current window, and ledger-exact on all 750 runs; what the study cannot yet deliver is a structure-independent answer to why fixation stops, recorded as an open decision for the expert rather than dressed up as a result.

biological_validation.basis: Calibrated to a current window; the per-condition Altair currents and the microkinetic class are needed before the catalytic-limitation claim can be called validated.

explanatory_gain.basis: Separates electrical from catalytic limitation, derives the Tutolo collapse from conductivity, and shows the empirical rate law cannot attribute the limitation — a structural result the empirical class alone could not produce.

derived.insight: Every one of the 375 grid points carries a limitation label in both runnable classes (coverage 1.00; 0 failed runs). Butler-Volmer: catalytic 226, electrical 149, transport 0, thermodynamic 0. Empirical: transport 147, catalytic 117, electrical 108, thermodynamic 3.

studies.name: og-01-cal-dx-label-disagreement
studies.title: Why do the empirical and Butler-Volmer classes disagree on the limitation label?
studies.question: Is the empirical-vs-Butler-Volmer disagreement on the dominant limitation label (they agree on only 47% of the region both call favorable) a real structural difference in how each class represents electrical, catalytic, and transport limits, or an avoidable artifact of binning and threshold placement?

studies.name: og-autocatalysis-a2
studies.title: Endogenous Autocatalysis (A2): Formose and Reductive-TCA Routes
studies.question: Can vent-fed chemistry spontaneously form a balanced, self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats a matched null with equal input fluxes — across the two representable routes (rule-generated linear-C6 formose chemistry, and the curated branched reductive-TCA cycle) — or does it only fix carbon (persistence, A1) without self-amplifying (A2)?

findings.statement: Study 29 receives the full 27→29 bundle — H2 + inorganic-carbon flux, pH, T, ionic activities, catalyst state and time-dependent feeds — as typed inputs, verified complete before any network is assembled.
Study 29 receives the full 28→29 bundle — canonical species, balanced stoichiometry, rate forms, parameter bounds and confidence tags — as the reaction set, verified complete.

Stoichiometric detection plus kinetic simulation either exhibit a balanced, mass-conserving autocatalytic cycle with measurable amplification and net carbon fixation, or they do not; the finding reports which, with the amplification factor and net fixation when positive.

Any detected amplification must exceed a matched null (identical chemical input fluxes, autocatalytic topology removed); amplification not separable from the null is reported as feed-driven accumulation, not autocatalysis. This is the Gate A null arm.
The study reports the critical dilution rate above which any self-maintaining cycle collapses — its robustness envelope, not a single operating point.
Carbon, mass and charge close across the kinetic run with the 27 feeds as the only carbon/energy source; no untracked input.

If no genuine autocatalysis is found, the study isolates and names the missing precursor or rate-limiting mechanism — a clean negative is an accepted result that scopes downstream work, not a failure to hide.

Under vent H2 a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out across the x1-x50 sweep and does not self-amplify; the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate to alpha-ketoglutarate, +18 kJ/mol; acetyl to pyruvate, +31 kJ/mol) are uphill and too slow against washout, mirroring the real cycle's need for ferredoxin rather than H2.

The cycle is autocatalytic in topology - its net turn (1 oxaloacetate + 4 CO2 + 5 H2 -> 2 oxaloacetate + 3 H2O) doubles the carrier oxaloacetate with no explicit coefficient-2 doubling reaction - so a coefficient detector reads gain 0 by construction and only a coefficient-free functional discriminator can judge it. (Acetate is used as an acetyl-CoA surrogate; fumarate is lumped.)

In a labelled permissive counterfactual that lowers the carboxylation barrier, the rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar on the coefficient-free discriminator and is topology-specific - a degree-preserving null does not switch on - so the vent-condition negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a limitation of the cycle's wiring. This counterfactual is explicitly beyond-vent and is not a vent claim.

With the formose result, this resolves Gate A's A2 (endogenous autocatalysis) for the branched route - self-amplification is refuted under vent conditions, mechanistically, for both representable routes - and records the topology-capable finding as the basis for a possible stronger-reductant / beyond-vent follow-up, outside current vent scope.

studies.claim: Endogenous self-amplifying autocatalysis is refuted under vent conditions across both representable routes, each against its own matched null. The linear-C6 formose arm (og-29) is thermodynamically refuted and seed-independent: the canonical doubling step (r409, 2 glycolaldehyde <-> threose) runs toward condensation (dG0 -16.4 kJ/mol) at vent feeds, so the splitting direction carries no net flux (gain 0, motifs 0 across x1-x50) and production is feed-driven, not self-amplified. The branched reductive-TCA arm (og-rtca) is autocatalytic in TOPOLOGY (its net turn doubles oxaloacetate with no coefficient-2 reaction, so a coefficient detector reads 0 by construction and a coefficient-free functional discriminator is required), yet washes out under vent H2 because the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate->a-ketoglutarate +18, acetyl->pyruvate +31 kJ/mol) run uphill and too slow against washout — the same reason the biological cycle uses ferredoxin, not H2. In a LABELLED beyond-vent counterfactual (lower carboxylation barrier + lower dilution) the same rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar and is topology-specific (the matched null stays off), so the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a defect of the cycle's wiring. The counterfactual is explicitly not a vent claim. Headline verdict is bounded by the honest negative of both arms: refuted. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.

derived.insight: Study 29 receives the full 27→29 bundle — H2 + inorganic-carbon flux, pH, T, ionic activities, catalyst state and time-dependent feeds — as typed inputs, verified complete before any network is assembled.

studies.name: og-self-compartmentation
studies.title: Self-Compartmentation: From Boundary to Self-Maintaining Protocell
studies.question: How does a vent-born chemical system acquire a self-made boundary and become a self-maintaining protocell — do amphiphiles assemble a retaining-but-not-isolating boundary, does encapsulation PAY against a matched equal-feed null, does the integrated compartment self-maintain and beat a matched ablation, and are real fatty-acid vesicles stable — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
methods: MD-informed membrane permeability (short Martini CG-MD structural proxy)
matched no-endogenous-membrane ablation (permeability open, equal feeds)

findings.statement: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles at alkaline vent pH and seawater ionic strength, where a single fatty acid does not — reproducing the Jordan-2019 broadening of the pH / salt / divalent stability window.

evidence.observed: mixed viable ~8000; single-fatty-acid viable 0 at 0.35 M salt

findings.explanation: ProtocellAssemblyProcess broadens the pH window + salt/divalent tolerance with the co-surfactant fraction (coarse-grained, Jordan-calibrated).

findings.statement: The viable compartments retain internal chemistry (retention 0.91) while staying permeable to the external gradient (access 1.0) — a non-empty individuality-without-isolation region (product ≈ 0.90), the key requirement for a protocell that does not cut itself off from geochemical energy.

evidence.observed: retention 0.91 × access 1.0 ≈ 0.90

findings.explanation: Selective permeability — low effective permeability to large/charged internal metabolites, higher to small external resources.

findings.statement: Sweeping permeability (via temperature) traces the compartment through THREE regimes on the retention-access plane — too closed (retains but starves; low T), a viable window (individuality + access, peak ret×acc ≈ 0.92 at ~310 K), and too open (leaks; high T) before the membrane destabilizes entirely. Orthogonally, the viable SALT ceiling rises with co-surfactant fraction: the feasibility map marks a viable region (individuality > 0.1) at 63/256 points (~25%) — vesicles survive at seawater salt (0.35 M) and beyond only with enough co-surfactant — the Jordan mixed-amphiphile advantage as a bounded 2-D region, not a single point.

evidence.observed: retention 0.97→0 and access rising to 1.00 then falling to 0 across 285–360 K; feasibility viable (individ>0.1) at 63/256 points, viable salt ceiling rising with mix_fraction

findings.explanation: Temperature sweep → retention-access arc; (mix × ionic strength) sweep → salt-tolerance feasibility map; rendered as the retention-access Decision view.

findings.statement: The parameter sweep exposed that an exact mix_fraction=0.0 is swallowed by process-bigraph's is_empty(Float, 0.0) and refilled with the default (0.4), which would silently turn the single-fatty-acid control into a mixed-amphiphile run. The composite now clamps 0.0 to a negligible 1e-6 and reads mix_fraction via a state input, so the control is honored. (The study runner had already dodged it with 0.001.)
findings.explanation: A sweep axis starting at exactly 0.0 revealed the gotcha; the fix hardens the composite for any caller passing 0.0.

findings.statement: The boundary forms from acetate+formate-derived amphiphile; with synthesis ablated it does not — boundary formation is caused by the endogenous chemistry.

Under the reduced-coupling model, at the Jordan-2019 vent-calibrated retention 0.905 / access 0.997, an endogenous membrane raises the standing metabolite pool (TOC) to about 2.9x the no-membrane ablation on the Gate-B pore-concentrated carbon-fixing network - the membrane pays for itself on persistence. Guardrail: this network is the sustained A1 carbon-fixing metabolism, not autocatalytic (A2 is refuted), so this is "a persisting network makes a membrane that pays for itself," not autocatalysis.

Net carbon-fixation flux under the membrane is about 0.6x the ablation - lower, not higher. Throughput is feed-limited, so reduced washout grows the standing pool, not the fixation rate; the benefit is on persistence, not throughput, and is reported as such. (The physically-expected result, not a shortfall: compartmentalization buys retention/concentration, not faster chemistry.)

The persistence benefit is windowed - it holds for membrane access down to about 0.45 and inverts below ~0.45, where a too-tight membrane starves the feed and the retained pool drops below the open system. The failure boundary is located and the vent-calibrated access (0.997) sits inside the window (mirrors Gate B's windowed discipline).

This is a reduced-coupling membrane model (retention/access), explicitly NOT the MD-resolved permeability PMF. It is the "benefits from it" half of Gate C and complements og-31's Martini-MD cohesion (the "makes a membrane" half). The structurally-resolved coupling (amphiphile composition to permeability to retention) and thus full Gate C requires study 32 (First Self-Maintaining Protocell) plus the viva-md-membrane coupling (to-build).

As in Gate B, the network_connected proxy is brittle at high standing pool - membrane connectivity reads 0 at high TOC accumulation. This is flagged and does not change the persistence result, which is based on the standing metabolite pool (TOC), not connectivity.

At equal feeds vs the no-endogenous-membrane ablation, the compartment SELF-MAINTAINS in the measurable form (verdict qualified). (i) Integrity: net amphiphile production 3.48e-5 >= degradation 1.0e-7 (eta_amph 0.10, k_deg 1e-4/s, M_req 1e-3 M) - maintained. (ii) Benefit: the membrane beats the ablation on persistence (standing organic carbon 1.77e-2 vs 8.96e-3, 1.98x) but NOT on throughput (net carbon flux 0.79x, feed-limited) - so the benefit is retention, not faster chemistry, exactly as og-31 found under the reduced coupling. Self-maintaining = integrity AND benefit = true; qualified because the benefit is persistence-only and the coupling is MD-informed, not PMF-resolved. Guardrail: the metabolism is the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network, not autocatalytic.

Membrane permeability is informed by REAL short Martini 3 CG-MD of the amphiphile composition, not a free parameter: the long di-C16 bilayer (thickness 2.870 nm) is thicker than the short di-C12 one (2.325 nm), and a published solubility-diffusion structure->permeability relation (a labelled proposed_input) maps that to lower permeability (0.256 vs 1.0 rel.) and higher retention (0.661 vs 0.333); retention lowers effective washout and raises the standing pool, so composition informs permeability informs retention. This is an MD-informed structural proxy, NOT a PMF-resolved permeability (Option A, study og-32a). It tightens the composition->permeability->retention chain that og-31 approximated with a reduced-coupling proxy.

Study 32 takes full Gate C on an MD-informed first cut (Option B): composition-informed permeability->retention with the measurable self-maintenance criterion (integrity + persistence benefit over the matched ablation), verdict qualified - advancing og-31's partial, reduced-coupling result by deriving retention from a real MD observable rather than a free knob. The matched-null is the no-endogenous-membrane ablation at equal feeds; self-maintenance is the measurable criterion, not strict autopoietic closure. The result is windowed (integrity holds up to k_deg <= ~0.01/s; the persistence benefit tracks the MD composition). The PMF-resolved permeability (Option A, og-32a) is the gold-standard budgeted follow-up that would re-test the verdict under a structurally-resolved permeability.

Real single-chain fatty-acid vesicles (viva-openmm Martini 3, ~1054 lipids, 3 independent MD seeds/arm) hold a closed bilayer across the entire protonated C10-C16 chain window: every chain keeps a populated inner leaflet (inner_leaflet_fraction 0.39-0.41, well above the 0.20 bilayer threshold) and a coherent, non-dispersed head shell (head_radial_cv 0.227-0.247, well below the 0.35 micelle threshold), with all 3/3 seeds stable at each chain and tight spread (std <= 0.01). So the protocell boundary forms and holds for the real amphiphile across the chain-length axis on this short-MD stability trend.

The matched null - the SAME fatty acid with fully-ionised charged-only (SQ5n) heads - micellises at the short-chain corner: C10 charged disperses in all 3/3 seeds (head_radial_cv 0.433 +/- 0.009, above the 0.35 threshold), the control that should fail. The charge effect is chain-length-gated within this short window: C14 charged still holds a coherent shell (cv 0.296 +/- 0.009, 3/3 stable), i.e. charge-driven micellisation of the LONGER chains is slower than ~0.8 ns CPU-MD resolves. So the destabilising corner is short chain + fully charged, exactly where fatty-acid physics (highest curvature + strongest headgroup repulsion) predicts the vesicle-forming threshold is crossed; the converged charge/chain boundary is the GPU gold-standard follow-up.

This study replaces og-32's DLPC/DPPC phospholipid planar-bilayer STAND-IN with the real protocell amphiphile: a closed bilayer VESICLE of single-chain fatty acids built + integrated in martini_openmm (Martini 3 fatty-acid defs FAnn/FAnnM + vesicle builder + semi-isotropic membrane barostat, finite energy). The Gate-C boundary is now the actual amphiphile, judged by a bilayer-vs-micelle discriminator (inner-leaflet / lumen retention) over >= 3 seeds. Verdict qualified: a SHORT-MD stability TREND, not a converged micellisation equilibrium or a permeability PMF - those are the GPU gold-standard follow-ups (og-32c self-assembly, og-32a PMF). The SP2/SQ5n head is a tracked Martini-3 building-block proposed_input; the C1 tails are authoritative.

studies.claim: A vent-born system acquires a self-made boundary and self-maintains as a protocell, with the membrane buying persistence rather than raw throughput. Mixed fatty-acid/alcohol amphiphiles assemble into protocell boundaries in a vent window, giving individuality (retention) without full isolation and beating single-amphiphile controls (og-04, supported); a boundary also forms endogenously from the system's own carbon chemistry with a closed matter ledger (og-04-alt, supported); protometabolism-produced encapsulation PAYS against a matched equal-feed null on persistence and an access window but NOT on throughput, and the benefit is windowed (og-31, qualified); the integrated compartment self-maintains its membrane integrity and beats a matched ablation with MD-informed permeability (og-32, canonical, qualified); and real fatty-acid Martini-3 vesicles are stable across C10-C16 while a fully-charged null micellises at the short+charged corner, replacing og-32's phospholipid stand-in with a real amphiphile (og-32b, qualified — a short-MD fixed-charge stability trend, with the titratable/PMF gold standard tracked as og-32a). Headline verdict qualified. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.

derived.insight: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles at alkaline vent pH and seawater ionic strength, where a single fatty acid does not — reproducing the Jordan-2019 broadening of the pH / salt / divalent stability window.

studies.name: og-reproduction
studies.title: Reproduction: Coupled Growth and Division into a Lineage
studies.question: How does a self-maintaining protocell reproduce — does metabolism drive growth to a measured-geometry division with viable daughters (not lysis or starvation), building a multi-generation lineage, each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
methods: study-32 self-maintaining protocell (A1 network + MD-informed membrane)
division at a measured critical-geometry threshold

findings.statement: At equal feeds vs the matched nulls, the protocell grows from its own metabolic amphiphile production and divides at a measured area-doubling budding geometry with no imposed event. Division RATE scales with metabolic flux in the coupled arm (0.0125 -> 0.0500 as net carbon flux 3.36e-4 -> 1.16e-3; slope > 0) while the growth-decoupled null is flux-INDEPENDENT (slope ~ 0) and the imposed-division null divides on a timer (rate ~0.044) regardless of geometry. So growth/division is metabolism-driven and beats both matched nulls - qualified (met on the measured-geometry first cut, Option B). Guardrail: growth is funded by the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network, not autocatalysis.

Daughters resume the study-32 self-maintenance criterion (net amphiphile production >= degradation) across the flux sweep (daughter_viable = 1.0) - division is counted as reproduction because the daughters are viable (resume self-maintenance), not merely formed.

Division is triggered at a MEASURED area-doubling budding geometry (division_ratio 2.0; a proposed_input grounded in the hanczyc/budin growth-division geometries), not a tuned event - the coupled and growth-decoupled arms both use the geometry, and only the imposed-division control divides on a timer. Full coarse-grained membrane mechanics (viva-md-membrane) is the gold-standard follow-on (og-33a) that would re-test division under resolved membrane physics rather than a measured geometric criterion.

In the matched regime the internal autocatalytic source accumulates product, the osmotic pressure it generates draws solvent in, and the compartment grows to the division threshold and divides repeatedly (8 divisions over the run) — the chemistry changes the compartment's physical fate, a physical selection mechanism without an abstract fitness score.

evidence.observed: 8 divisions; outcome = divide; net growth sawtooth driven by osmotic pressure ~1.2e5 Pa

findings.explanation: OsmoticGrowthDivisionProcess integrates dN/dt (autocatalytic source − leak), Pi = R·T·c_in (van 't Hoff), dV/dt = Lp·A·Pi (solvent influx), and halves V and N at the division threshold.

findings.statement: Sustained net growth leading to division occupies a BOUNDED band of (network throughput × membrane permeability) — about a quarter of the swept grid — flanked by starvation where the membrane is too permeable (the product leaks out so the osmotic pressure never builds and nothing grows) and by lysis where it is too impermeable (the product is trapped, the pressure spikes past the burst tension and the membrane ruptures). Permeability, not throughput alone, decides whether autocatalysis produces a dividing protocell.

evidence.observed: matched → 8 divisions; too permeable (P=1e-5 m/s) → 0 divisions, net growth ~1.00 (starve); too impermeable (P=1e-10 m/s, high throughput) → lysed at ~1.5e5 Pa

findings.explanation: The equilibrium internal concentration scales as throughput / (permeability · area); below a floor the osmotic drive cannot grow the compartment (starve), above a ceiling it exceeds the burst pressure before division can relieve it (lyse).

findings.statement: The growth is driven by the chemistry, not by the compartment physics alone — with the autocatalytic source ablated (zero throughput) the compartment neither grows nor divides, while mass stays conserved across the whole cycle (residual ~4e-32 mol).

evidence.observed: ablation (throughput ~0) → 0 divisions, net growth ~1.04; favorable → 8 divisions; mass residual ~4e-32 mol

findings.explanation: With no source the only osmolyte is the small seed; the osmotic pressure stays far below the drive needed to reach the division threshold, and division halving conserves mass exactly.

findings.statement: A founder grows, divides, and its daughters do the same — a >=3-generation lineage forms in the agents map, matter and volume conserved at every division.

studies.claim: A self-maintaining protocell reproduces by metabolism-coupled growth and division into a lineage. Metabolism drives growth to a division at measured geometry with viable daughters, beating a null where growth is decoupled from metabolism or division is imposed (og-33, qualified); net throughput grows the compartment to division rather than lysis or starvation, mass-conserved, where a no-throughput ablation does not (og-growth-division, supported); and a growing, dividing individual builds a >=3-generation lineage with volume conserved across division (og-growth-alt, supported). Headline verdict qualified (coarse-grained geometry/budget abstraction); every matched null and every arm verdict preserved.

derived.insight: At equal feeds vs the matched nulls, the protocell grows from its own metabolic amphiphile production and divides at a measured area-doubling budding geometry with no imposed event.
